essay.zh: 您好！我的名字叫大明，我是台灣人。
essay.py: Nínhǎo! Wǒ de míngzi jiào dàmíng, wǒ shì táiwān rén.
essay.en: Hello! My name is Daming. I am Taiwanese.

essay.zh: 你好！他是誰？
essay.py: Nǐhǎo! Tā shì shéi?
essay.en: Hi! Who is he?

essay.zh: 他是我的同學，他是美國人。
essay.py: Tā shì wǒ de tóngxué, tā shì Měiguó rén.
essay.en: He is my classmate. He is American.

essay.zh: 她是日本人，她的家在東京。
essay.py: Tā shì Rìběn rén, tā de jiā zài dōngjīng.
essay.en: She is Japanese. Her home is in Tokyo.

essay.zh: 我們三個人都不是中國人。你們是哪國人？
essay.py: Wǒmen sāngè rén dōu búshì Zhōngguó rén. Nǐmen shì nǎguórén?
essay.en: None of the three of us is Chinese. What country are you from?

essay.zh: 他們的姓名和電話，我都寫在本子上了。
essay.py: Tāmen de xìngmíng hé diànhuà, wǒ dōu xiě zài běnzi shàng le.
essay.en: I wrote their full names and phone numbers in my notebook.

essay.zh: 我們每天有兩個小時的時間一起學中文。
essay.py: Wǒmen měitiān yǒu liǎnggè xiǎoshí de shíjiān yīqǐ xué Zhōngwén.
essay.en: Every day we have two hours to study Chinese together.

essay.zh: 今年我二十八歲。
essay.py: Jīnnián wǒ èrshíbā suì.
essay.en: This year I am twenty-eight.

essay.zh: 現在是早上七點，我要去上班。
essay.py: Xiànzài shì zǎoshàng qīdiǎn, wǒyào qù shàngbān.
essay.en: It is seven in the morning now. I am going to work.

essay.zh: 昨天上午我工作了三個小時，中午吃了一碗麵。
essay.py: Zuótiānshàngwǔ wǒ gōngzuò le sāngè xiǎoshí, zhōngwǔ chī le yīwǎn miàn.
essay.en: Yesterday morning I worked for three hours, and at noon I ate a bowl of noodles.

essay.zh: 今天下午四點我有中文課，五點下課。
essay.py: Jīntiānxiàwǔ sìdiǎn wǒ yǒu Zhōngwén kè, wǔdiǎn xiàkè.
essay.en: Today at 4 p.m. I have Chinese class; it ends at five.

essay.zh: 晚上九點我回家，十點睡覺。
essay.py: Wǎnshàng jiǔdiǎn wǒ huíjiā, shídiǎn shuìjiào.
essay.en: At 9 p.m. I go home, and at ten I go to sleep.

essay.zh: 明天是星期六，我想睡到十點。
essay.py: Míngtiān shì xīngqīliù, wǒ xiǎng shuì dào shídiǎn.
essay.en: Tomorrow is Saturday. I want to sleep until ten.

words.en: individual measure word for persons and material things
measure word for the age of people or animals

essay.zh: 我家有七個人：爸爸、媽媽、哥哥、姊姊、弟弟、妹妹和我。
essay.py: Wǒjiā yǒuqīgè rén: bàba, māma, gēge, zǐzǐ, dìdi, mèimei hé wǒ.
essay.en: There are seven people in my family: Dad, Mom, older brother, older sister, younger brother, younger sister and me.

essay.zh: 我是家裡的第五個孩子，今年二十六歲。
essay.py: Wǒ shì jiālǐ de dìwǔ gè háizi, jīnnián èrshíliù suì.
essay.en: I am the fifth child in the family. I am twenty-six this year.

essay.zh: 我們住在台中，哥哥一年半以前來台北工作。
essay.py: Wǒmen zhù zài tái zhōng, gēge yīnián bàn yǐqián lái táiběi gōngzuò.
essay.en: We live in Taichung. My older brother came to Taipei to work a year and a half ago.

essay.zh: 哥哥有兩個孩子。
essay.py: Gēge yǒu liǎnggè háizi.
essay.en: My older brother has two children.

essay.zh: 小時候，我們每天晚上八點十分一起看電視。
essay.py: Xiǎo shíhòu, wǒmen měitiānwǎnshàng bādiǎn shífēn yīqǐ kàndiànshì.
essay.en: When we were little, we watched TV together every evening at 8:10.

essay.zh: 那個時候，爸爸常常給我一百塊，有時候給我一千塊！
essay.py: Nàgè shíhòu, bàba chángcháng gěiwǒ yìbǎi kuài, yǒushíhou gěiwǒ yīqiān kuài!
essay.en: At that time, Dad often gave me 100 dollars, and sometimes he gave me 1,000!

words.en: to feel, to think, to consider
to be beautiful, to be pretty
to be tall, to be high

essay.zh: 大家好，我姓王，我是王先生。
essay.py: Dàjiā hǎo, wǒxìng wáng, wǒ shì wángxiānshēng.
essay.en: Hello everyone. My surname is Wang. I am Mr. Wang.

essay.zh: 我太太是老師，她很漂亮。
essay.py: Wǒ tàitai shì lǎoshī, tā hěnpiàoliàng.
essay.en: My wife is a teacher. She is very beautiful.

essay.zh: 我們有一個兒子和一個女兒。
essay.py: Wǒmen yǒu yīgè érzi hé yīgè nǚ'ér.
essay.en: We have a son and a daughter.

essay.zh: 兒子很高，女兒真可愛。我覺得我的孩子都很好。
essay.py: Érzi hěn gāo, nǚ'ér zhēn kě'ài. Wǒ juéde wǒ de háizi dōu hěn hǎo.
essay.en: My son is tall, and my daughter is really cute. I think my children are both great.

essay.zh: 我的老朋友李先生喜歡晚上打電話給我。
essay.py: Wǒ de lǎopéngyǒu lǐxiānshēng xǐhuān wǎnshàng dǎ diànhuà gěiwǒ.
essay.en: My old friend Mr. Li likes to call me in the evening.

essay.zh: 他家有三個孩子，兩個男孩、一個女孩。
essay.py: Tājiā yǒusāngè háizi, liǎnggè nánhái, yīgè nǚhái.
essay.en: His family has three children: two boys and one girl.

essay.zh: 他的大女兒是林小姐的學生。
essay.py: Tā de dà nǚ'ér shì línxiǎojiě de xuéshēng.
essay.en: His oldest daughter is Miss Lin's student.

words.en: measure word for numbers and dates

essay.zh: 今天是五月十二號，星期天，是我的生日。
essay.py: Jīntiān shì wǔyuè shíèr hào, Xīngqítiān, shì wǒ de shēngrì.
essay.en: Today is Sunday, May 12th. It is my birthday.

essay.zh: 在台灣，很多人說「禮拜天」，也說「星期日」。
essay.py: Zài táiwān, hěnduō rén shuō “Lǐbàitiān” , yě shuō “Xīngqírì” .
essay.en: In Taiwan, many people say "lǐbàitiān" and also "xīngqírì" for Sunday.

essay.zh: 去年生日，我太忙了，一天都在工作。
essay.py: Qùnián shēngrì, wǒtàimáng le, yītiān dōu zài gōngzuò.
essay.en: On my birthday last year, I was too busy and worked all day.

essay.zh: 今年週末，朋友們在公園給我唱生日歌。
essay.py: Jīnnián zhōumò, péngyǒu men zài gōngyuán gěiwǒchàng shēngrìgē.
essay.en: This year on the weekend, my friends sang me a birthday song in the park.

essay.zh: 他們送我一個新手機，我從早上到晚上都很快樂。
essay.py: Tāmen sòng wǒ yīgè xīn shǒujī, wǒ cóng zǎoshàng dào wǎnshàng dōu hěn kuàilè.
essay.en: They gave me a new phone. I was happy from morning to night.

essay.zh: 回家的路上，我想：我愛這個國家。
essay.py: Huíjiā de lùshàng, wǒ xiǎng: wǒ àizhègè guójiā.
essay.en: On the way home I thought: I love this country.

essay.zh: 明年生日，我想去別的國家玩。
essay.py: Míngnián shēngrì, wǒ xiǎng qù biéde guójiā wán.
essay.en: On my next birthday, I want to visit another country.

essay.zh: 前天晚上，我和家人一起看以前的照片。
essay.py: Qiántiān wǎnshàng, wǒ hé jiārén yīqǐ kàn yǐqián de zhàopiàn.
essay.en: The night before yesterday, I looked at old photos with my family.

essay.zh: 照片裡的我又矮又胖，現在我比較瘦了。
essay.py: Zhàopiàn lǐde wǒ yòu ǎi yòu pàng, xiànzài wǒ bǐjiào shòu le.
essay.en: In the photos I was short and fat. Now I am thinner.

essay.zh: 媽媽說，我的眼睛最美。
essay.py: Māma shuō, wǒ de yǎnjīng zuìměi.
essay.en: Mom says my eyes are the most beautiful.

essay.zh: 我每天運動一個鐘頭，走一萬步。
essay.py: Wǒ měitiān yùndòng yīgè zhōngtóu, zǒu yīwànbù.
essay.en: I exercise for an hour every day and walk ten thousand steps.

essay.zh: 運動以後，我的手和腳都非常累，可是我不怕累。
essay.py: Yùndòng yǐhòu, wǒ de shǒu hé jiǎo dōu fēicháng lèi, kěshì wǒ bùpàlèi.
essay.en: After exercising, my hands and feet are very tired, but I am not afraid of being tired.

essay.zh: 醫生說，我應該每天睡前休息二十分鐘，也不要太晚睡。
essay.py: Yīshēng shuō, wǒ yīnggāi měitiān shuìqián xiūxí èrshí fēnzhōng, yě búyào tài wǎnshuì.
essay.en: The doctor says I should rest for twenty minutes before bed every day and not sleep too late.

essay.zh: 後天我要自己去爬山，因為身體健康很重要。
essay.py: Hòutiān wǒyào zìjǐ qù páshān, yīnwèi shēntǐ jiànkāng hěn zhòngyào.
essay.en: The day after tomorrow I will go hiking by myself, because a healthy body is important.

words.en: to have a cold; cold, flu
to become ill, to be sick
to see a doctor; to see a patient

essay.zh: 昨天我生病了，我感冒了。
essay.py: Zuótiān wǒ shēngbìng le, wǒ gǎnmào le.
essay.en: Yesterday I got sick. I caught a cold.

essay.zh: 我的頭很痛，鼻子不舒服，耳朵也痛。
essay.py: Wǒdetóu hěn tòng, bízi bù shūfu, ěrduo yě tòng.
essay.en: My head hurts a lot, my nose feels bad, and my ears hurt too.

essay.zh: 我很累，可是睡不著。
essay.py: Wǒ hěn lèi, kěshì shuìbùzhù.
essay.en: I am very tired, but I can't fall asleep.

essay.zh: 我不餓，只想喝水，因為嘴巴很乾。
essay.py: Wǒ bù è, zhǐxiǎng hēshuǐ, yīnwèi zuǐba hěn qián.
essay.en: I am not hungry. I only want to drink water, because my mouth is dry.

essay.zh: 家裡的小孩子都生病了。
essay.py: Jiālǐ de xiǎoháizi dōu shēngbìng le.
essay.en: All the little kids at home are sick.

essay.zh: 媽媽問：「你要在家休息，還是去看病？」
essay.py: Māma wèn: “nǐ yào zàijiā xiūxí, háishì qù kànbìng?”
essay.en: Mom asked, "Do you want to rest at home, or go see a doctor?"

essay.zh: 我說：「我沒事，這個病不嚴重，吃藥就好了。」
essay.py: Wǒ shuō: “wǒ méishì, zhègè bìng bù yánzhòng, chīyào jiù hǎo le.”
essay.en: I said, "I'm OK. This illness isn't serious. I'll be fine after taking medicine."

words.en: indicates the completion of an action
two or more bi1n used before verbs to express the simultaneous progression or development of two or more actions
a verbal suffix, indicating the action or the state is continuing

essay.zh: 我的中文老師說得很好，也很有意思。
essay.py: Wǒ de Zhōngwén lǎoshī shuōde hěn hǎo, yě hěn yǒuyìsi.
essay.en: My Chinese teacher speaks very well and is very interesting.

essay.zh: 我沒有去過她家，可是我跟她一起吃過飯。
essay.py: Wǒ méiyǒu qùguò tājiā, kěshì wǒ gēn tā yīqǐ chī guòfàn.
essay.en: I have never been to her home, but I have eaten with her.

essay.zh: 因為明天有考試，所以我今天有點緊張。
essay.py: Yīnwèi míngtiān yǒu kǎoshì, suǒyǐ wǒ jīntiān yǒudiǎn jǐnzhāng.
essay.en: Because there is a test tomorrow, I am a little nervous today.

essay.zh: 老師說：「別擔心，你一定可以。」
essay.py: Lǎoshī shuō: “bié dānxīn, nǐ yídìng kěyǐ.”
essay.en: The teacher said, "Don't worry, you can definitely do it."

essay.zh: 我得馬上回家，然後用電腦練習。
essay.py: Wǒ děimǎshàng huíjiā, ránhòu yòng diànnǎo liànxí.
essay.en: I have to go home right away and then practice on the computer.

essay.zh: 我一邊聽音樂，一邊看著書。
essay.py: Wǒ yībiān tīng yīnyuè, yībiān kàn zhùshū.
essay.en: I listen to music while looking at my book.

essay.zh: 今天可能會很晚睡，我和我的書都累了。
essay.py: Jīntiān kěnéng huì hěn wǎnshuì, wǒ hé wǒ de shū dōu lèi le.
essay.en: I might sleep late tonight. My book and I are both tired.

words.en: individual measure word for rod-shaped article
measure word for floor or story
to drive, to open, to turn on

essay.zh: 我爸爸是醫生，他的工作很忙。
essay.py: Wǒ bàba shì yīshēng, tā de gōngzuò hěn máng.
essay.en: My dad is a doctor. His work is very busy.

essay.zh: 我們的房子在山下，空氣很好。
essay.py: Wǒmen de fángzi zài shānxià, kōngqì hěn hǎo.
essay.en: Our house is at the foot of a mountain. The air is very good.

essay.zh: 房子旁邊有一頭牛和兩隻豬。
essay.py: Fángzi pángbiān yǒu yītóu niú hé liǎng zhī zhū.
essay.en: There is a cow and two pigs next to the house.

essay.zh: 我的房間在二樓，有一張床、一張桌子和一把椅子。
essay.py: Wǒ de fángjiān zài èrlóu, yǒu yī zhāngchuáng, yīzhāng zhuōzi hé yībǎ yǐzi.
essay.en: My room is on the second floor. It has a bed, a table and a chair.

essay.zh: 桌子上有三枝筆。
essay.py: Zhuōzi shàng yǒu sānzhī bǐ.
essay.en: There are three pens on the table.

essay.zh: 今天下大雨，我開門的時候，看到門口都是水。
essay.py: Jīntiān xià dàyǔ, wǒ kāimén de shíhòu, kàndào ménkǒu dōu shì shuǐ.
essay.en: Today it rained hard. When I opened the door, the doorway was full of water.

essay.zh: 所以我們在家看電視，那是爸爸上個月買的。
essay.py: Suǒyǐ wǒmen zàijiā kàndiànshì, nà shì bàba shànggè yuè mǎi de.
essay.en: So we watched TV at home. Dad bought it last month.

words.en: to be not bad, pretty good

essay.zh: 我是大學的學生，在學校學中文。
essay.py: Wǒ shì dàxué de xuéshēng, zài xuéxiào xué Zhōngwén.
essay.en: I am a university student, studying Chinese at school.

essay.zh: 我的同學問我：「這個字怎麼寫？」
essay.py: Wǒ de tóngxué wènwǒ: “zhègè zì zěnme xiě?”
essay.en: My classmate asked me, "How do you write this character?"

essay.zh: 我用筆寫給他看。
essay.py: Wǒyòngbǐ xiěgěi tā kàn.
essay.en: I wrote it with a pen to show him.

essay.zh: 週末天氣不錯，我們去山上玩。
essay.py: Zhōumò tiānqì búcuò, wǒmen qù shānshàng wán.
essay.en: On the weekend the weather was nice, so we went to the mountains.

essay.zh: 山上不冷也不熱，可是風很大，下午還下雨了。
essay.py: Shānshàng bùlěng yě bùrè, kěshì fēng hěndà, xiàwǔ háixià yǔ le.
essay.en: It was neither cold nor hot on the mountain, but it was very windy, and it even rained in the afternoon.

essay.zh: 我們看了很多花，晚上吃了魚和雞。
essay.py: Wǒmen kàn le hěnduō huā, wǎnshàng chī le yúhéjī.
essay.en: We saw many flowers, and in the evening we ate fish and chicken.

essay.zh: 老師說，出去玩也是學中文的好方法。
essay.py: Lǎoshī shuō, chūqùwán yě shì xué Zhōngwén de hǎo fāngfǎ.
essay.en: The teacher says going out to have fun is also a good way to learn Chinese.

words.en: can or to be capable of
to go to class, to attend classs
individual measure word for books or magazines etc
individual measure word for flat things, or things with a surface
①to read; to go to; ②attend school or college
can, to be able to, to be good at, to be skillful in

essay.zh: 我每天早上九點上課。
essay.py: Wǒ měitiān zǎoshàng jiǔdiǎn shàngkè.
essay.en: I have class at nine every morning.

essay.zh: 上課的時候，我聽老師說話，也寫一些漢字。
essay.py: Shàngkè de shíhòu, wǒ tīng lǎoshī shuōhuà, yě xiě yīxiē hànzì.
essay.en: In class, I listen to the teacher and write some Chinese characters.

essay.zh: 我會說英文，也會說一點中文。
essay.py: Wǒhuì shuō Yīngwén, yě huì shuō yīdiǎn Zhōngwén.
essay.en: I can speak English, and I can speak a little Chinese.

essay.zh: 我不知道一個字的意思的時候，就問老師。
essay.py: Wǒ bù zhīdào yīgè zì de yìsi de shíhòu, jiùwèn lǎoshī.
essay.en: When I don't know the meaning of a character, I ask the teacher.

essay.zh: 老師說：「對！問問題很好。」
essay.py: Lǎoshī shuō: “duì! Wèn wèntí hěn hǎo.”
essay.en: The teacher says, "Right! Asking questions is good."

essay.zh: 下課以後，我在餐廳讀一本書，也在一張紙上畫畫。
essay.py: Xiàkè yǐhòu, wǒ zài cāntīng dú yīběn shū, yě zài yī zhāngzhǐ shàng huàhuà.
essay.en: After class, I read a book in a restaurant and draw on a piece of paper.

essay.zh: 朋友問我為什麼喜歡中文。我說：「因為我能用中文聊天，也可以自己點菜。」
essay.py: Péngyǒu wènwǒ wèishénme xǐhuān Zhōngwén. Wǒ shuō: “yīnwèi wǒnéng yòng Zhōngwén liáotiān, yě kěyǐ zìjǐ diǎncài.”
essay.en: A friend asked why I like Chinese. I said, "Because I can chat in Chinese, and I can also order food by myself."

words.en: to get out of class, end of class
to speak, to say, to talk
①to reach, to arrive; ②up to
measure word for the times of an action

essay.zh: 今天的中文課有考試。
essay.py: Jīntiān de Zhōngwén kèyǒu kǎoshì.
essay.en: There was a test in today's Chinese class.

essay.zh: 考試以前，老師教我們念句子。
essay.py: Kǎoshì yǐqián, lǎoshī jiào wǒmen niàn jùzi.
essay.en: Before the test, the teacher taught us to read sentences aloud.

essay.zh: 我有一個句子念錯了，老師告訴我應該怎麼說，現在我懂了。
essay.py: Wǒ yǒu yīgè jùzi niàncuò le, lǎoshī gàosù wǒ yīnggāi zěnme shuō, xiànzài wǒ dǒng le.
essay.en: I read one sentence wrong. The teacher told me how to say it, and now I understand.

essay.zh: 下課以後，我在教室休息，跟同學說話。
essay.py: Xiàkè yǐhòu, wǒ zài jiàoshì xiūxí, gēn tóngxué shuōhuà.
essay.en: After class, I rested in the classroom and talked with classmates.

essay.zh: 然後我坐公車回家，路上車子很多。
essay.py: Ránhòu wǒ zuò gōngchē huíjiā, lùshàng chēzi hěnduō.
essay.en: Then I took the bus home. There were many cars on the road.

essay.zh: 到家以後，我開始寫功課。
essay.py: Dàojiā yǐhòu, wǒ kāishǐ xiě gōngkè.
essay.en: After I got home, I started my homework.

essay.zh: 這個週末，我想去那家新的咖啡店。
essay.py: Zhègè zhōumò, wǒ xiǎng qù nàjiā xīn de kāfēidiàn.
essay.en: This weekend I want to go to that new coffee shop.

essay.zh: 朋友問我：「你住在哪裡？」
essay.py: Péngyǒu wènwǒ: “nǐ zhù zài nǎlǐ?”
essay.en: A friend asked me, "Where do you live?"

essay.zh: 我說：「我住在學校附近，你可以坐公車來，也可以開車來。」
essay.py: Wǒ shuō: “wǒ zhù zài xuéxiào fùjìn, nǐ kěyǐ zuò gōngchē lái, yě kěyǐ kāichē lái.”
essay.en: I said, "I live near the school. You can come by bus or by car."

essay.zh: 「你家怎麼走？」「下車以後往前走，左邊是銀行，右邊是公園，我家就在公園旁邊。」
essay.py: “Nǐjiā zěnme zǒu?” “Xiàchē yǐhòu wǎngqiánzǒu, zuǒbiān shì yínháng, yòubiān shì gōngyuán, wǒjiā jiù zài gōngyuán pángbiān.”
essay.en: "How do I get to your home?" "After getting off, walk forward. The bank is on the left, the park is on the right, and my home is next to the park."

essay.zh: 我家前面有一條河，後面是一座山，這裡是一個很安靜的地方。
essay.py: Wǒjiā qiánmiàn yǒu yītiáo hé, hòu miànshì yīzuò shān, zhèlǐ shì yīgè hěnānjìng de dìfāng.
essay.en: There is a river in front of my home and a mountain behind it. This is a very quiet place.

essay.zh: 家裡不大，房間裡面有很多書，桌子上面有電腦，下面睡著一隻貓。
essay.py: Jiālǐ bùdà, fángjiān lǐmiàn yǒu hěnduō shū, zhuōzi shàngmiàn yǒu diànnǎo, xiàmiàn shuìzhù yī zhī māo.
essay.en: My home isn't big. There are many books in the room, a computer on the table, and a cat sleeping under it.

essay.zh: 我常在外面看書，那裡風很涼。
essay.py: Wǒcháng zài wàimiàn kànshū, nàlǐ fēng hěn liáng.
essay.en: I often read outside. The breeze there is cool.

essay.zh: 你想去哪家餐廳吃飯？來的時候，請帶一點水果吧！
essay.py: Nǐ xiǎng qù nǎjiā cāntīng chī fàn? Lái de shíhòu, qǐngdài yīdiǎn shuǐguǒ ba!
essay.en: Which restaurant do you want to eat at? When you come, please bring some fruit!

words.en: to bring, to carry (in one's, or with one's hand)
measure word for any conveyance etc
①to produce, to turn out, to arise, to happen; ②to issue, to put out, to post, to put forth, to pay out

essay.zh: 我今天早上五點起床，因為要坐飛機去外國。
essay.py: Wǒ jīntiān zǎoshàng wǔdiǎn qǐchuáng, yīnwèi yào zuò fēijī qù wàiguó.
essay.en: I got up at five this morning, because I'm flying abroad.

essay.zh: 我穿好衣服，拿了行李就出門。
essay.py: Wǒ chuān hǎo yīfú, ná le xínglǐ jiù chūmén.
essay.en: I got dressed, took my luggage and went out.

essay.zh: 我先坐計程車去火車站，那輛計程車開得很快。
essay.py: Wǒ xiān zuò jìchéngchē qù huǒchē zhàn, nàliàng jìchéngchē kāide hěnkuài.
essay.en: First I took a taxi to the train station. That taxi drove very fast.

essay.zh: 可是火車很慢，還好在台灣坐火車很方便，用手機就能買票。
essay.py: Kěshì huǒchē hěnmàn, háihǎo zài táiwān zuò huǒchē hěn fāngbiàn, yòng shǒujī jiù néng mǎipiào.
essay.en: But the train was slow. Luckily, taking the train in Taiwan is convenient; you can buy tickets with your phone.

essay.zh: 到了機場，我進咖啡店喝了一杯咖啡，我朋友喝茶。
essay.py: Dào le jīchǎng, wǒjìn kāfēidiàn hē le yībēi kāfēi, wǒ péngyǒu hēchá.
essay.en: At the airport, I went into a café and had a coffee. My friend had tea.

essay.zh: 飛機要飛很久，所以我在飛機上睡覺。
essay.py: Fēijī yào fēi hěn jiǔ, suǒyǐ wǒ zài fēijī shàng shuìjiào.
essay.en: The flight is long, so I slept on the plane.

essay.zh: 飛機到了，我站起來拿行李。
essay.py: Fēijī dào le, wǒ zhàn qǐlái ná xínglǐ.
essay.en: When the plane arrived, I stood up and got my luggage.

words.en: question particle, implying probability/sentence suffix, indicating a request
a question particle/a particle indicating the situation or state of affairs is being sustain
no problem, never mind, it doesn' t matter

essay.zh: 「請問，這個東西叫什麼？」
essay.py: “Qǐngwèn, zhègè dōngxi jiào shénme?”
essay.en: "Excuse me, what is this thing called?"

essay.zh: 「這個叫珍珠奶茶。你要試試嗎？」
essay.py: “Zhègè jiào zhēnzhūnǎichá. Nǐ yào shìshì ma?”
essay.en: "This is called bubble tea. Do you want to try it?"

essay.zh: 「多少錢？」「五十塊。」
essay.py: “Duōshǎo qián?” “Wǔshí kuài.”
essay.en: "How much is it?" "Fifty dollars."

essay.zh: 「對不起，我沒有零錢，給你一百塊，可以嗎？」
essay.py: “Duìbùqǐ, wǒ méiyǒu língqián, gěinǐ yìbǎi kuài, kěyǐ ma?”
essay.en: "Sorry, I don't have change. Can I give you a hundred?"

essay.zh: 「沒關係，找你五十塊。」
essay.py: “Méiguānxi, zhǎo nǐ wǔshí kuài.”
essay.en: "No problem. Here are your fifty dollars change."

essay.zh: 「謝謝！我想介紹這家店給我的朋友。你呢？下班以後做什麼？」
essay.py: “Xièxie! Wǒ xiǎng jièshào zhèjiā diàngěi wǒ de péngyǒu. Nǐ ne? Xiàbān yǐhòu zuòshénme?”
essay.en: "Thanks! I want to introduce this shop to my friends. What about you? What do you do after work?"

essay.zh: 「沒什麼事，回家休息吧。這個奶茶怎麼樣？」「很好喝！再見！」
essay.py: “Méishénme shì, huíjiā xiūxí ba. Zhègè nǎichá zěnmeyàng?” “Hěn hǎohē! Zàijiàn!”
essay.en: "Nothing much, just go home and rest. How's the milk tea?" "Delicious! Bye!"

words.en: to be big, to be large
to have; there is, there are

essay.zh: 我想買新衣服，所以去了一家店。
essay.py: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi xīn yīfú, suǒyǐ qù le yījiā diàn.
essay.en: I wanted to buy new clothes, so I went to a shop.

essay.zh: 我看見兩件一樣的衣服，一件大，一件小。
essay.py: Wǒ kànjian liǎngjiàn yíyàng de yīfú, yījiàn dà, yījiàn xiǎo.
essay.en: I saw two identical pieces of clothing, one big and one small.

essay.zh: 大的比小的貴，要五百元；小的很便宜。
essay.py: Dà de bǐ xiǎo de guì, yào wǔbǎiyuán; xiǎo de hěn piányí.
essay.en: The big one is more expensive than the small one, 500 dollars; the small one is cheap.

essay.zh: 那條裙子太長了，這條又太短了。
essay.py: Nàtiáo qúnzi tàizhǎng le, zhètiáo yòu tàiduǎn le.
essay.en: That skirt is too long, and this one is too short.

essay.zh: 買衣服不難，可是找到喜歡的不容易。
essay.py: Mǎi yīfú bùnán, kěshì zhǎodào xǐhuān de bù róngyì.
essay.en: Buying clothes isn't hard, but finding ones you like isn't easy.

essay.zh: 這家店也有鞋子，我買了一雙。
essay.py: Zhèjiādiàn yě yǒu xiézi, wǒ mǎi le yīshuāng.
essay.en: This shop also has shoes. I bought a pair.

essay.zh: 買完東西，我去吃飯，吃得很飽。
essay.py: Mǎi wán dōngxi, wǒ qù chī fàn, chīde hěn bǎo.
essay.en: After shopping, I went to eat and got very full.

to be alike, to be like; to resemble
to watch, to read, to look at
just, exactly; then, right away; (indicating immediacy)

essay.zh: 我每天很早起床，先運動，再吃早飯。
essay.py: Wǒ měitiān hěnzǎo qǐchuáng, xiān yùndòng, zài chī zǎofàn.
essay.en: I get up very early every day. First I exercise, then I eat breakfast.

essay.zh: 我常常走路去學校，走二十分鐘就到了。
essay.py: Wǒ chángcháng zǒulù qù xuéxiào, zǒu èrshí fēnzhōng jiù dào le.
essay.en: I often walk to school; it takes just twenty minutes.

essay.zh: 以前我喜歡打球，現在喜歡看書。
essay.py: Yǐqián wǒ xǐhuān dǎqiú, xiànzài xǐhuān kànshū.
essay.en: I used to like playing ball; now I like reading.

essay.zh: 週末我跟朋友去看電影，也去玩。
essay.py: Zhōumò wǒ gēn péngyǒu qù kàn diànyǐng, yě qù wán.
essay.en: On weekends I go to the movies with friends and go out to have fun.

essay.zh: 電影院在一家舊書店旁邊，看起來像以前的老房子。
essay.py: Diànyǐngyuàn zài yījiā jiù shūdiàn pángbiān, kànqǐlái xiàng yǐqián de lǎofángzi.
essay.en: The cinema is next to an old bookstore that looks like an old house from the past.

essay.zh: 我們一共看了兩部電影。
essay.py: Wǒmen yígòng kàn le liǎngbù diànyǐng.
essay.en: We watched two movies in total.

essay.zh: 看完以後，我們等公車回家。
essay.py: Kàn wán yǐhòu, wǒmen děng gōngchē huíjiā.
essay.en: After watching, we waited for the bus home.

still, yet, also, too, as well, besides

individual measure word for clothes etc
cup; trophy cup; classifier for certain containers of liquids: glass, cup

essay.zh: 昨天是我朋友的生日，她請我們幾位朋友吃飯。
essay.py: Zuótiān shì wǒ péngyǒu de shēngrì, tā qǐng wǒmen jǐwèi péngyǒu chī fàn.
essay.en: Yesterday was my friend's birthday. She treated a few of us to a meal.

essay.zh: 我們吃了很多菜和肉，大家都用筷子。
essay.py: Wǒmen chī le hěnduō cài hé ròu, dàjiā dōu yòng kuàizi.
essay.en: We ate lots of dishes and meat, and everyone used chopsticks.

essay.zh: 我喝了一杯果汁，杯子很漂亮。
essay.py: Wǒ hē le yībēi guǒzhī, bēizi hěnpiàoliàng.
essay.en: I drank a glass of juice. The glass was very pretty.

essay.zh: 我送她一件衣服，三百塊。
essay.py: Wǒ sòng tā yījiàn yīfú, sānbǎi kuài.
essay.en: I gave her a piece of clothing; it was 300 dollars.

essay.zh: 吃完飯，我們去唱歌、跳舞。
essay.py: Chī wánfàn, wǒmen qù chànggē, tiàowǔ.
essay.en: After eating, we went singing and dancing.

essay.zh: 她唱的歌很好聽，她又唱又跳。
essay.py: Tā chàngdegē hěn hǎo tīng, tā yòu chàng yòu tiào.
essay.en: Her songs sounded great; she sang and jumped around.

essay.zh: 東西不夠吃，我們還買了一個蛋糕。
essay.py: Dōngxi búgòu chī, wǒmen háimǎi le yīgè dàngāo.
essay.en: There wasn't enough food, so we also bought a cake.

essay.zh: 早上我常吃麵包和蛋，喝一杯牛奶。
essay.py: Zǎoshàng wǒcháng chī miànbāo hé dàn, hēyībēi niúnǎi.
essay.en: In the morning I often eat bread and eggs and drink a glass of milk.

essay.zh: 中午我去餐廳看菜單，點了餃子、一碗麵和湯。
essay.py: Zhōngwǔ wǒ qù cāntīng kàn càidān, diǎnle jiǎozi, yīwǎn miàn hétāng.
essay.en: At noon I went to a restaurant, looked at the menu, and ordered dumplings, a bowl of noodles and soup.

essay.zh: 台灣的食物很多，我也喜歡吃包子。
essay.py: Táiwān de shíwù hěnduō, wǒ yě xǐhuān chī bāozi.
essay.en: Taiwan has lots of food. I also like steamed buns.

essay.zh: 我多吃水果，少喝酒。
essay.py: Wǒ duō chīshuǐguǒ, shǎo hējiǔ.
essay.en: I eat more fruit and drink less alcohol.

essay.zh: 我最喜歡的水果是香蕉，最喜歡的飲料是果汁。
essay.py: Wǒ zuì xǐhuān de shuǐguǒ shì xiāngjiāo, zuì xǐhuān de yǐnliào shì guǒzhī.
essay.en: My favorite fruit is banana, and my favorite drink is juice.

essay.zh: 我不太愛吃甜的東西，可是生日的時候，我會吃一點巧克力蛋糕。
essay.py: Wǒ bùtàiàichī tián de dōngxi, kěshì shēngrì de shíhòu, wǒhuì chī yīdiǎn qiǎokèlì dàngāo.
essay.en: I don't love sweet things, but on my birthday I eat a little chocolate cake.

words.en: grandpa, grandfather (father's father); a respectful form of address for an old man

essay.zh: 我的家庭很大，爺爺和奶奶也跟我們住。
essay.py: Wǒ de jiātíng hěndà, yéye hé nǎinai yě gēn wǒmen zhù.
essay.en: My family is big. Grandpa and Grandma also live with us.

essay.zh: 前年爺爺送我一隻小狗，它很可愛。
essay.py: Qiánnián yéye sòng wǒ yī zhī xiǎogǒu, tā hěn kě'ài.
essay.en: The year before last, Grandpa gave me a puppy. It is very cute.

essay.zh: 它喜歡在外頭玩球。
essay.py: Tā xǐhuān zài wàitou wánqiú.
essay.en: It likes to play with a ball outside.

essay.zh: 後年我想再養兩隻貓，讓它們跟小狗一起玩。
essay.py: Hòunián wǒxiǎng zàiyǎng liǎng zhī māo, ràng tāmen gēn xiǎogǒu yīqǐ wán.
essay.en: The year after next, I want to get two cats so they can play with the puppy.

essay.zh: 奶奶常帶我去夜市吃小吃，夏天我們吃一碗冰。
essay.py: Nǎinai chángdài wǒ qù yèshì chī xiǎochī, xiàtiān wǒmen chī yīwǎn bīng.
essay.en: Grandma often takes me to the night market for snacks. In summer we eat a bowl of shaved ice.

essay.zh: 有一次，我在夜市見到我的老師，真的很高興。
essay.py: Yǒu yīcì, wǒ zài yèshì jiàn dào wǒ de lǎoshī, zhēnde hěn gāoxìng.
essay.en: Once I saw my teacher at the night market. I was really happy.

essay.zh: 很多人中，我聽見奶奶叫我。
essay.py: Hěnduō rénzhōng, wǒ tīngjiàn nǎinai jiào wǒ.
essay.en: Among many people, I heard Grandma call me.

essay.zh: 冬天山上很冷，氣溫很低，有時候只有零度。
essay.py: Dōngtiān shānshàng hěn lěng, qìwēn hěn dī, yǒushíhou zhǐyǒu língdù.
essay.en: In winter it's cold in the mountains; the temperature is low, sometimes only zero degrees.

essay.zh: 奶奶常說：大人要幫助別人。
essay.py: Nǎinai chángshuō: dàrén yào bāngzhù biérén.
essay.en: Grandma often says: adults should help other people.

words.en: formerly, in the past, used to

essay.zh: 我住的城市叫台北市。
essay.py: Wǒ zhù de chéngshì jiào táiběishì.
essay.en: The city I live in is called Taipei City.

essay.zh: 從前這條街上住了很多老人，現在住了很多年輕人。
essay.py: Cóngqián zhètiáo jiēshàng zhù le hěnduō lǎorén, xiànzài zhù le hěnduō niánqīng rén.
essay.en: In the past, many old people lived on this street; now many young people live here.

essay.zh: 我的鄰居是一個男生和一個女生，他們剛剛結婚。
essay.py: Wǒ de línjū shì yīgè nánshēng hé yīgè nǚshēng, tāmen gānggāng jiéhūn.
essay.en: My neighbors are a guy and a girl who just got married.

essay.zh: 他們給我他們的電話號碼和地址，也給我電子郵件。
essay.py: Tāmen gěiwǒ tāmen de diànhuà hàomǎ hé dìzhǐ, yěgěi wǒ diànzǐyóujiàn.
essay.en: They gave me their phone number and address, and their email too.

essay.zh: 台北的春天很舒服，夏天很熱，秋天很涼快，冬天有一點冷。
essay.py: Táiběi de chūntiān hěn shūfu, xiàtiān hěnrè, qiūtiān hěn liángkuài, dōngtiān yǒuyīdiǎn lěng.
essay.en: Spring in Taipei is comfortable, summer is hot, autumn is cool, and winter is a bit cold.

essay.zh: 我每個禮拜都去找他們聊天。
essay.py: Wǒ měigè lǐbài dōu qù zhǎo tāmen liáotiān.
essay.en: I visit them to chat every week.

essay.zh: 今天我到的時候，他們在做飯。我在他們家坐了一會兒，就回家了。
essay.py: Jīntiān wǒ dào de shíhòu, tāmen zài zuò fàn. Wǒ zài tāmen jiā zuò le yīhuǐr, jiù huíjiā le.
essay.en: Today when I arrived, they were cooking. I sat at their place for a while, then went home.

words.en: to smile, to laugh, to laugh at
to be nervous, to be tense
to be lovable, likeable, adorable, cute
to be angry; to take offense
to be sad, to be distressed

essay.zh: 我姊姊是護士，每天照顧病人，工作很辛苦。
essay.py: Wǒ zǐzǐ shì hùshì, měitiān zhàogù bìngrén, gōngzuò hěn xīnkǔ.
essay.en: My older sister is a nurse. She takes care of patients every day; the work is hard.

essay.zh: 她說，第一次工作的時候很緊張，現在有經驗了。
essay.py: Tā shuō, dìyīcì gōngzuò de shíhòu hěn jǐnzhāng, xiànzài yǒu jīngyàn le.
essay.en: She says she was nervous when she first started; now she has experience.

essay.zh: 有一個小病人很可愛也很聰明，頭髮短短的。
essay.py: Yǒu yīgè xiǎo bìngrén hěn kě'ài yě hěn cōngmíng, tóufǎ duǎnduǎnde.
essay.en: One little patient is cute and smart, with short hair.

essay.zh: 他肚子痛的時候會哭，好一點的時候會笑。
essay.py: Tā dùzitòng de shíhòu huì kū, hǎo yīdiǎn de shíhòu huìxiào.
essay.en: When his tummy hurts he cries; when he feels better he laughs.

essay.zh: 姊姊用手指在他的臉上畫了一個笑臉，他很高興，也願意吃藥了。
essay.py: Zǐzǐ yòng shǒuzhǐ zài tā de liǎn shànghuà le yīgè xiào liǎn, tā hěn gāoxìng, yě yuànyì chīyào le.
essay.en: My sister drew a smiley face on his face with her finger. He was happy and became willing to take his medicine.

essay.zh: 有時候病人會生氣，姊姊也會難過，可是她已經習慣了。
essay.py: Yǒushíhou bìngrén huì shēngqì, zǐzǐ yě huì nánguò, kěshì tā yǐjīng xíguàn le.
essay.en: Sometimes patients get angry and my sister feels sad, but she's used to it.

essay.zh: 我相信她是一個好護士。當然，她現在更愛這個工作了。
essay.py: Wǒ xiāngxìn tā shì yīgè hǎo hùshì. Dāngrán, tā xiànzài gèngàizhègè gōngzuò le.
essay.en: I believe she is a good nurse. Of course, now she loves this job even more.

words.en: to cross; to pass; to spend (time)
indicating pre-verbal object as thing dealt with by the action
used in a passive sentence structure to introduce the agent; to let, to allow, to permit, to make

essay.zh: 我本來在一家公司的辦公室工作。
essay.py: Wǒ běnlái zài yījiā gōngsī de bàngōngshì gōngzuò.
essay.en: I originally worked in a company office.

essay.zh: 雖然工作不難，但是每天坐那麼久，身體不舒服。
essay.py: Suīrán gōngzuò bùnán, dànshì měitiān zuò nàme jiǔ, shēntǐ bù shūfu.
essay.en: Although the work wasn't hard, sitting so long every day made my body feel bad.

essay.zh: 有一天，我的眼鏡被我坐壞了。
essay.py: Yǒu yītiān, wǒ de yǎnjìng bèi wǒ zuòhuài le.
essay.en: One day, I sat on my glasses and broke them.

essay.zh: 我去醫院看醫生，醫生說：「要是你不運動，就會不健康。」
essay.py: Wǒ qù yīyuàn kàn yīshēng, yīshēng shuō: “yàoshì nǐ bù yùndòng, jiù huì bù jiànkāng.”
essay.en: I went to the hospital. The doctor said, "If you don't exercise, you will become unhealthy."

essay.zh: 這讓我很擔心，我決定把工作換了，現在當工人，在外面工作。
essay.py: Zhèràng wǒ hěn dānxīn, wǒ juédìng bǎ gōngzuò huànle, xiànzài dāng gōngrén, zài wàimiàn gōngzuò.
essay.en: That made me worried. I decided to change jobs; now I'm a worker and work outdoors.

essay.zh: 每天下班，我過馬路去公園走走。
essay.py: Měitiān xiàbān, wǒguò mǎlù qù gōngyuán zǒuzǒu.
essay.en: Every day after work, I cross the road to walk in the park.

essay.zh: 工作的時候很容易渴，我常喝水或是喝茶。
essay.py: Gōngzuò de shíhòu hěn róngyì kě, wǒcháng hēshuǐ huòshì hēchá.
essay.en: I get thirsty easily while working, so I often drink water or tea.

essay.zh: 我從來沒有這麼開心過，我的心也輕鬆了。
essay.py: Wǒ cónglái méiyǒu zhème kāixīn guò, wǒ de xīn yě qīngsōng le.
essay.en: I've never been this happy before; my heart feels relaxed too.

words.en: to begin work, to start work, to go to work
to get off from work, to go off work
to make great effort, try hard
if, in case, in the event of
container measure word for houses or other buildings

essay.zh: 我住在一座大樓的十樓。
essay.py: Wǒ zhù zài yīzuò dàlóu de shílóu.
essay.en: I live on the 10th floor of a tall building.

essay.zh: 樓上住著一位護士，樓下住著一位計程車司機。
essay.py: Lóushàng zhù zhù yīwèi hùshì, lóuxià zhù zhù yīwèi jìchéngchē sījī.
essay.en: A nurse lives upstairs, and a taxi driver lives downstairs.

essay.zh: 每天早上我坐電梯去上班；如果電梯壞了，我就走樓梯。
essay.py: Měitiān zǎoshàng wǒ zuò diàntī qù shàngbān; rúguǒ diàntī huài le, wǒ jiù zǒu lóutī.
essay.en: Every morning I take the elevator to go to work; if it's broken, I take the stairs.

essay.zh: 我的老闆是賣咖啡的。
essay.py: Wǒ de lǎo bǎn shì mài kāfēi de.
essay.en: My boss sells coffee.

essay.zh: 我很努力工作，因為我打算明年自己開一間咖啡店。
essay.py: Wǒ hěn nǔlì gōngzuò, yīnwèi wǒ dǎsuàn míngnián zìjǐ kāiyījiān kāfēidiàn.
essay.en: I work hard because I plan to open my own coffee shop next year.

essay.zh: 這是我的計畫，我正在準備，希望會有這個機會。
essay.py: Zhèshì wǒ de jìhuà, wǒ zhèngzài zhǔnbèi, xīwàng huìyǒu zhègè jīhuì.
essay.en: This is my plan. I'm preparing and hope I'll get the chance.

essay.zh: 下班以後，我在廚房做飯，在客廳看書。
essay.py: Xiàbān yǐhòu, wǒ zài chúfáng zuòfàn, zài kètīng kànshū.
essay.en: After work, I cook in the kitchen and read in the living room.

words.en: to close, to shut; to turn off

essay.zh: 我在台北租了一間小房子，房租不太貴。
essay.py: Wǒ zài táiběi zū le yījiān xiǎofángzi, fángzū bùtàiguì.
essay.en: I rented a small place in Taipei. The rent isn't too expensive.

essay.zh: 家裡有一些舊家具：一張沙發和一個冰箱。
essay.py: Jiālǐ yǒu yīxiē jiù jiājù: yīzhāng shāfā hé yīgè bīngxiāng.
essay.en: There's some old furniture: a sofa and a fridge.

essay.zh: 我每天把家裡打掃得很乾淨。
essay.py: Wǒ měitiān bǎ jiālǐ dǎsǎode hěn gānjìng.
essay.en: I clean my home every day and keep it very clean.

essay.zh: 晚上我關燈、開冷氣，我的貓睡在沙發上。
essay.py: Wǎnshàng wǒ guāndēng, kāilěngqì, wǒ de māoshuì zài shāfā shàng.
essay.en: At night I turn off the lights and turn on the AC; my cat sleeps on the sofa.

essay.zh: 窗子外面有一條河和一個湖，常常有鳥飛過。
essay.py: Chuāngzi wàimiàn yǒu yītiáo hé hé yīgè hú, chángcháng yǒu niǎo fēiguò.
essay.en: Outside the window there's a river and a lake; birds often fly past.

essay.zh: 我想去看看世界。我想去下雪的地方，看雪，在火旁邊喝熱茶。
essay.py: Wǒ xiǎng qù kànkàn shìjiè. Wǒ xiǎng qù xiàxuě de dìfāng, kànxuě, zài huǒpángbiān hē rèchá.
essay.en: I want to see the world. I want to go somewhere it snows, look at the snow, and drink hot tea by the fire.

essay.zh: 我也想看馬在地上跑。
essay.py: Wǒ yě xiǎng kàn mǎ zài dìshàng pǎo.
essay.en: I also want to watch horses run on the ground.

words.en: individual measure word for insects or animals
to take a bath or shower
to attend school, to be at school
to start school, to begin term
measure word for a group of organized people

essay.zh: 我妹妹今年上小學三年級，她班上有二十個學生。
essay.py: Wǒ mèimei jīnnián shàng xiǎoxué sānnián jí, tā bānshàng yǒu èrshí gè xuéshēng.
essay.en: My younger sister is in third grade this year. Her class has twenty students.

essay.zh: 開學的第一天，她很早就起床上學。
essay.py: Kāixué de dìyītiān, tā hěn zǎojiù qǐchuáng shàngxué.
essay.en: On the first day of school, she got up very early to go to school.

essay.zh: 老師在黑板上寫字，她看著課本學華語。
essay.py: Lǎoshī zài hēibǎn shàng xiě zì, tā kàn zhù kèběn xué Huáyǔ.
essay.en: The teacher writes on the blackboard, and she studies Mandarin from her textbook.

essay.zh: 回家以後，她用字典寫作業，她的成績很好。
essay.py: Huíjiā yǐhòu, tā yòng zìdiǎn xiě zuòyè, tā de chéngjī hěn hǎo.
essay.en: At home she does homework with a dictionary. Her grades are very good.

essay.zh: 她說，語言很有意思。
essay.py: Tā shuō, yǔyán hěn yǒuyìsi.
essay.en: She says languages are very interesting.

essay.zh: 週末我們帶家裡的兩隻狗去海邊。
essay.py: Zhōumò wǒmen dàijiālǐ de liǎng zhī gǒu qù hǎibiān.
essay.en: On the weekend we took our two dogs to the beach.

essay.zh: 太陽很大，狗在草地上高興地跑，我們在樹下休息。
essay.py: Tàiyáng hěndà, gǒu zài cǎodìshàng gāoxìngde pǎo, wǒmen zài shùxià xiūxí.
essay.en: The sun was strong. The dogs ran happily on the grass and we rested under a tree.

essay.zh: 回家以後，我們先給狗洗澡。
essay.py: Huíjiā yǐhòu, wǒmen xiāngěi gǒu xǐzǎo.
essay.en: After getting home, we first gave the dogs a bath.

words.en: to pay attention to, to take notice of
to attend, to participate, to take part in

essay.zh: 我決定參加一個中文班，學習台灣文化。
essay.py: Wǒ juédìng cānjiā yīgè Zhōngwén bān, xuéxí táiwān wénhuà.
essay.en: I decided to join a Chinese class and learn about Taiwanese culture.

essay.zh: 老師講得很清楚，常常問問題，我們要回答。
essay.py: Lǎoshī jiǎngde hěn qīngchǔ, chángcháng wèn wèntí, wǒmen yào huídá.
essay.en: The teacher explains clearly and often asks questions that we must answer.

essay.zh: 我認為最好的方法是每天練習。
essay.py: Wǒ rènwéi zuìhǎo de fāngfǎ shì měitiān liànxí.
essay.en: I think the best method is to practice every day.

essay.zh: 我每天讀書一個鐘頭，也注意自己的發音。
essay.py: Wǒ měitiān dúshū yīgè zhōngtóu, yě zhùyì zìjǐ de fāyīn.
essay.en: I study an hour every day and pay attention to my pronunciation.

essay.zh: 有時候我會忘了一些字，所以我把它們寫在本子上，就記得了。
essay.py: Yǒushíhou wǒhuì wàng le yīxiē zì, suǒyǐ wǒ bǎ tāmen xiě zài běnzi shàng, jiù jìde le.
essay.en: Sometimes I forget some characters, so I write them in a notebook and then I remember.

essay.zh: 我跟同學借了一本書，很有用。我們每個星期都要交作業。
essay.py: Wǒ gēn tóngxué jiè le yīběn shū, hěn yǒuyòng. Wǒmen měigè xīngqí dōu yào jiāo zuòyè.
essay.en: I borrowed a book from a classmate; it's very useful. We have to hand in homework every week.

essay.zh: 算一算，我已經學了三個月，我的中文進步了很多，這個辦法真的不錯。
essay.py: Suànyīsuàn, wǒ yǐjīng xuéle sāngè yuè, wǒ de Zhōngwén jìnbù le hěnduō, zhègè bànfǎ zhēnde búcuò.
essay.en: Let me count: I've studied for three months, and my Chinese has improved a lot. This method really works.

the other side, place across from

essay.zh: 我下個月要去日本旅行。
essay.py: Wǒ xiàgè yuè yào qù Rìběn lǚxíng.
essay.en: Next month I'm going on a trip to Japan.

essay.zh: 我先從宿舍坐公車到車站，再坐火車去機場。
essay.py: Wǒ xiān cóng sùshè zuò gōngchē dào chēzhàn, zài zuò huǒchē qù jīchǎng.
essay.en: First I'll take a bus from the dorm to the station, then a train to the airport.

essay.zh: 到了東京，我住在一家小旅館，對面有一家很大的飯店。
essay.py: Dào le dōngjīng, wǒ zhù zài yījiā xiǎo lǚguǎn, duìmiàn yǒu yījiā hěndà de fàndiàn.
essay.en: In Tokyo I'll stay at a small inn; across from it is a big hotel.

essay.zh: 我帶著地圖和照相機，去參觀一個有名的圖書館。
essay.py: Wǒ dài zhù dìtú hé zhàoxiàngjī, qù cānguān yīgè yǒumíng de túshūguǎn.
essay.en: I'll take a map and a camera to visit a famous library.

essay.zh: 走過馬路的時候要小心，因為汽車很多。
essay.py: Zǒuguò mǎlù de shíhòu yào xiǎoxīn, yīnwèi qìchē hěnduō.
essay.en: You must be careful crossing the road because there are many cars.

essay.zh: 在十字路口，我問一個人：「請問，洗手間在哪裡？」
essay.py: Zài shízìlùkǒu, wǒ wènyīgè rén: “qǐngwèn, xǐshǒujiān zài nǎlǐ?”
essay.en: At the crossroads, I'll ask someone, "Excuse me, where is the restroom?"

essay.zh: 那裡的風景好美哪！我在那裡照相，也把買的東西放在袋子裡。
essay.py: Nàlǐ de fēngjǐng hǎoměina! Wǒ zài nàlǐ zhàoxiàng, yě bǎ mǎi de dōngxi fàngzài dàizi lǐ.
essay.en: The scenery there is so beautiful! I'll take pictures and put what I buy in a bag.

words.en: between, among, in the middle of

essay.zh: 台灣的北部有台北，南部有高雄，中間有台中。
essay.py: Táiwān de běibù yǒu táiběi, nánbù yǒu gāoxióng, zhōngjiān yǒutái zhōng.
essay.en: Northern Taiwan has Taipei, the south has Kaohsiung, and Taichung is in the middle.

essay.zh: 我家在東部，離台北很遠，離海很近。
essay.py: Wǒjiā zài dōngbù, lí táiběi hěnyuǎn, líhǎi hěn jìn.
essay.en: My home is in the east, far from Taipei and close to the sea.

essay.zh: 有空的時候，我會開車經過山路去台北。
essay.py: Yǒukòng de shíhòu, wǒhuì kāichē jīngguò shānlù qù táiběi.
essay.en: When I have free time, I drive over the mountain road to Taipei.

essay.zh: 到了台北，先往西走，一直走到第二個路口，再向右轉。
essay.py: Dào le táiběi, xiānwǎng xī zǒu, yīzhí zǒu dào dìèr gè lùkǒu, zài xiàng yòuzhuǎn.
essay.en: In Taipei, first head west, go straight to the second intersection, then turn right.

essay.zh: 最後，我到了朋友家，把禮物送給她。
essay.py: Zuìhòu, wǒ dào le péngyǒujiā, bǎ lǐwù sònggěi tā.
essay.en: Finally I reach my friend's home and give her a present.

essay.zh: 我放下東西，洗了手。
essay.py: Wǒ fàngxià dōngxi, xǐ le shǒu.
essay.en: I put my things down and washed my hands.

essay.zh: 我要離開的時候，手機掉了，還好朋友找到了。
essay.py: Wǒyào líkāi de shíhòu, shǒujī diào le, háihǎo péngyǒu zhǎodào le.
essay.en: When I was about to leave, I dropped my phone. Luckily my friend found it.

words.en: meal; to eat; classifier for meals
to celebrate the Chinese New Year
to ride; to drive (a bicycle, motorcycle, horse etc)

essay.zh: 我去年搬到新家，發現附近有很多運動的地方。
essay.py: Wǒ qùnián bāndào xīnjiā, fāxiàn fùjìn yǒu hěnduō yùndòng de dìfāng.
essay.en: I moved to a new home last year and found many places to exercise nearby.

essay.zh: 我常常騎腳踏車去公園踢足球、打籃球。
essay.py: Wǒ chángcháng qí jiǎotàchē qù gōngyuán tīzúqiú, dǎ lánqiú.
essay.en: I often ride my bike to the park to play soccer and basketball.

essay.zh: 夏天我去游泳，有時候也打網球。
essay.py: Xiàtiān wǒ qù yóuyǒng, yǒushíhou yě dǎ wǎngqiú.
essay.en: In summer I swim, and sometimes I play tennis.

essay.zh: 我喜歡看棒球比賽，常在報紙上或上網看新聞。
essay.py: Wǒ xǐhuān kàn bàngqiú bǐsài, chángzài bàozhǐ shàng huò shàngwǎng kàn xīnwén.
essay.en: I like watching baseball games, and I often read the news in the paper or online.

essay.zh: 過年的時候，家裡來了很多客人。
essay.py: Guònián de shíhòu, jiālǐ lái le hěnduō kèrén.
essay.en: During Chinese New Year, many guests came to our home.

essay.zh: 我們在門上掛了「新年快樂」，一起吃了很好吃的晚餐。
essay.py: Wǒmen zàimén shàngguà le “xīnnián kuàilè” , yīqǐ chī le hěn hǎochī de wǎncān.
essay.en: We hung "Happy New Year" on the door and had a delicious dinner together.

essay.zh: 吃完飯，我們去電影院看電影。
essay.py: Chī wánfàn, wǒmen qù diànyǐngyuàn kàn diànyǐng.
essay.en: After eating, we went to the cinema to see a movie.

words.en: to feel embarrassed; to be ill at ease
to meet sb, to see sb

essay.zh: 「喂？是小林嗎？我是大衛。」
essay.py: “Wèi? Shì xiǎolín ma? Wǒ shì dàwèi.”
essay.en: "Hello? Is that Xiaolin? This is David."

essay.zh: 「大衛！歡迎你來台灣！聽說你最近搬家了。」
essay.py: “Dàwèi! Huānyíng nǐ lái táiwān! Tīngshuō nǐ zuìjìn bānjiā le.”
essay.en: "David! Welcome to Taiwan! I heard you moved recently."

essay.zh: 「對。不好意思，麻煩你幫忙我一下，我的電腦壞了。」
essay.py: “Duì. Bùhǎoyìsi, máfán nǐ bāngmáng wǒ yíxià, wǒ de diànnǎo huài le.”
essay.en: "Yes. Sorry to bother you, could you help me? My computer is broken."

essay.zh: 「不客氣，我們是好朋友，別客氣。我們明天見面吧。」
essay.py: “Búkèqì, wǒmen shì hǎo péngyǒu, bié kèqi. Wǒmen míngtiān jiànmiàn ba.”
essay.en: "You're welcome. We're good friends, don't be so polite. Let's meet tomorrow."

essay.zh: 「好。我先去銀行，再去郵局寄一封信給媽媽，信封上寫著她的地址。」
essay.py: “Hǎo. Wǒ xiān qù yínháng, zài qù yóujú jì yīfēngxìn gěi māma, xìnfēng shàng xiě zhù tā de dìzhǐ.”
essay.en: "OK. I'll go to the bank first, then the post office to mail a letter to Mom. Her address is on the envelope."

essay.zh: 「好，我去郵局接你。我想介紹我的朋友給你認識。」
essay.py: “Hǎo, wǒ qù yóujú jiē nǐ. Wǒ xiǎng jièshào wǒ de péngyǒu gěinǐ rènshì.”
essay.en: "OK, I'll pick you up at the post office. I want to introduce my friend to you."

essay.zh: 「太好了！我也給你帶了一個禮物。對了，我不在家的時候，請你幫我喂貓。」
essay.py: “Tàihǎole! Wǒ yěgěi nǐ dài le yīgè lǐwù. Duì le, wǒ bù zàijiā de shíhòu, qǐng nǐ bāng wǒ wèimāo.”
essay.en: "Great! I brought you a present too. Oh, and please feed my cat when I'm not home."

words.en: affair; sth to do, a matter, event
to be important, to be vital

essay.zh: 今天我有很多事情要做。
essay.py: Jīntiān wǒ yǒu hěnduō shìqíng yào zuò.
essay.en: Today I have many things to do.

essay.zh: 早上我先去市場買菜，再去超市買白色的襪子。
essay.py: Zǎoshàng wǒ xiān qù shìchǎng mǎicài, zài qù chāoshì mǎi báisè de wàzi.
essay.en: In the morning I went to the market for groceries, then to the supermarket for white socks.

essay.zh: 然後我去書店，又去一家商店看手錶。
essay.py: Ránhòu wǒ qù shūdiàn, yòu qù yījiā shāngdiàn kànshǒu biǎo.
essay.en: Then I went to a bookstore, and then to a shop to look at watches.

essay.zh: 那支手錶是黃色的，顏色很漂亮。
essay.py: Nà zhīshǒu biǎo shì huángsè de, yánsè hěnpiàoliàng.
essay.en: That watch was yellow; the color was beautiful.

essay.zh: 我要付錢的時候，發現錢包不見了！「啊！怎麼辦？信用卡也在裡面，很重要。」
essay.py: Wǒyào fùqián de shíhòu, fāxiàn qiánbāo bújiàn le! “A! Zěnmebàn? Xìnyòngkǎ yě zài lǐmiàn, hěn zhòngyào.”
essay.en: When I was about to pay, I found my wallet was gone! "Ah! What do I do? My credit card is inside; it's important."

essay.zh: 那個店員長得很高，他拉著我說：「別急，我幫你找。」
essay.py: Nàgè diànyuán zhǎng de hěn gāo, tālāzhù wǒ shuō: “biéjí, wǒ bāng nǐ zhǎo.”
essay.en: The clerk, who was very tall, pulled me aside and said, "Don't panic, I'll help you look."

essay.zh: 最後在椅子下面找到了。我希望以後不會再發生這種事。
essay.py: Zuìhòu zài yǐzi xiàmiàn zhǎodào le. Wǒ xīwàng yǐhòu búhuì zài fāshēng zhèzhǒng shì.
essay.en: We finally found it under a chair. I hope this never happens again.

words.en: measure word for two things of the same kind to be used together
be similar to, be about the same...
①heavy, weighty; ②serious; ③strong, considerable in amount/value
to seem, to be likely, to be like

essay.zh: 冬天快到了，我去百貨公司買衣服。
essay.py: Dōngtiān kuàidào le, wǒ qù bǎihuògōngsī mǎi yīfú.
essay.en: Winter is coming, so I went to the department store to buy clothes.

essay.zh: 我試了一件大衣和一件外套，兩件的樣子差不多。
essay.py: Wǒshì le yījiàn dàyī hé yījiàn wàitào, liǎngjiàn de yàngzi chābùduō.
essay.en: I tried on an overcoat and a jacket; they looked about the same.

essay.zh: 外套比較輕，大衣比較重。
essay.py: Wàitào bǐjiào qīng, dàyī bǐjiào zhòng.
essay.en: The jacket is lighter; the overcoat is heavier.

essay.zh: 我也買了一雙鞋、一條褲子，還有一條裙子給妹妹。
essay.py: Wǒ yě mǎi le yīshuāngxié, yītiáo kùzi, háiyǒu yītiáo qúnzi gěi mèimei.
essay.en: I also bought a pair of shoes, a pair of pants, and a skirt for my younger sister.

essay.zh: 店員的聲音很好聽，她說：「這個帽子很特別，你戴戴看。」
essay.py: Diànyuán de shēngyīn hěn hǎo tīng, tā shuō: “zhègè màozi hěn tèbié, nǐ dài dài kàn.”
essay.en: The clerk had a nice voice. She said, "This hat is special. Try it on."

essay.zh: 那個皮包很簡單，好像也不錯，可是我沒買其他東西了。
essay.py: Nàgè píbāo hěn jiǎndān, hǎoxiàng yě búcuò, kěshì wǒ méi mǎi qítā dōngxi le.
essay.en: That handbag was simple and seemed nice too, but I didn't buy anything else.

essay.zh: 回家的時候下雨了，走路要小心。
essay.py: Huíjiā de shíhòu xiàyǔ le, zǒulù yào xiǎoxīn.
essay.en: It rained on the way home, so I had to walk carefully.

words.en: to be strange, to be queer, to be unusual
measure word for the number of repetitions in a given period of time
indicate that an action happened later than expacted

essay.zh: 我平常總是一個人跑步。
essay.py: Wǒ píngcháng zǒngshì yīgè rén pǎobù.
essay.en: I usually always run alone.

essay.zh: 後來我在網站上看到一個跑步活動，就開始參加了。
essay.py: Hòulái wǒ zài wǎngzhàn shàng kàndào yīgè pǎobù huódòng, jiù kāishǐ cānjiā le.
essay.en: Later I saw a running event on a website and started joining.

essay.zh: 第一次去的時候，我覺得很奇怪，因為大家都聽著音樂跑。
essay.py: Dìyīcì qù de shíhòu, wǒ juéde hěn qíguài, yīnwèi dàjiā dōu tīng zhù yīnyuè pǎo.
essay.en: The first time I went, I thought it was strange, because everyone ran while listening to music.

essay.zh: 跑完以後，大家一起聊天，說自己的故事，也看照片。
essay.py: Pǎo wán yǐhòu, dàjiā yīqǐ liáotiān, shuō zìjǐ de gùshi, yě kàn zhàopiàn.
essay.en: After running, everyone chats, tells their stories, and looks at photos.

essay.zh: 各國的人都有，我們已經是好朋友了。
essay.py: Gèguó de rén dōu yǒu, wǒmen yǐjīng shì hǎo péngyǒu le.
essay.en: There are people from every country, and we're already good friends.

essay.zh: 這個活動不需要買票。
essay.py: Zhègè huódòng bù xūyào mǎipiào.
essay.en: This event doesn't need a ticket.

essay.zh: 我跑了三個月才變得比較快。下個月，我要把跑鞋還給朋友。
essay.py: Wǒ pǎo le sāngè yuè cái biànde bǐjiào kuài. Xiàgè yuè, wǒyào bǎ pǎoxié huángěi péngyǒu.
essay.en: It took three months of running before I got faster. Next month, I'll return the running shoes to my friend.

words.en: container measure word for the contents of a plate
partial measure word for thin, flat pieces of sth
container measure word for the contents of a bottle

essay.zh: 週末我們在家開派對，準備了很多點心。
essay.py: Zhōumò wǒmen zàijiā kāi pàiduì, zhǔnbèi le hěnduō diǎnxīn.
essay.en: On the weekend we had a party at home and prepared lots of snacks.

essay.zh: 有三明治、漢堡、青菜沙拉，還有一盤西瓜和蘋果。
essay.py: Yǒu sānmíngzhì, hànbǎo, qīngcài shālā, háiyǒu yīpán xīguā hé píngguǒ.
essay.en: There were sandwiches, hamburgers, green salad, and a plate of watermelon and apples.

essay.zh: 我用刀子把蘋果切成一片一片的。
essay.py: Wǒyòng dāozi bǎ píngguǒ qièchéng yīpiàn yīpiàn de.
essay.en: I used a knife to cut the apples into slices.

essay.zh: 桌上有叉子和湯匙，也有幾瓶啤酒和紅茶。
essay.py: Zhuōshàng yǒu chāzi hé tāngchí, yě yǒu jǐpíng píjiǔ hé hóngchá.
essay.en: On the table there were forks and spoons, and a few bottles of beer and black tea.

essay.zh: 紅茶太苦了，我加了一點糖。
essay.py: Hóngchá tàikǔ le, wǒjiā le yīdiǎn táng.
essay.en: The black tea was too bitter, so I added a little sugar.

essay.zh: 冰淇淋的味道很好，可是那個水果有一點酸。
essay.py: Bīngqílín de wèidào hěn hǎo, kěshì nàgè shuǐguǒ yǒuyīdiǎn suān.
essay.en: The ice cream tasted great, but that fruit was a little sour.

essay.zh: 我吃了一半就飽了。喝完的瓶子，我們都放在門口。
essay.py: Wǒ chī le yíbàn jiù bǎo le. Hēwán de píngzi, wǒmen dōu fàngzài ménkǒu.
essay.en: I was full after eating half. We put all the empty bottles by the door.

essay.zh: 我高中的時候喜歡做菜。
essay.py: Wǒ gāozhōng de shíhòu xǐhuān zuòcài.
essay.en: In high school I liked cooking.

essay.zh: 我會做很多種菜，有的鹹，有的辣，都很香。
essay.py: Wǒhuì zuò hěnduō zhǒngcài, yǒude xián, yǒude là, dōu hěn xiāng.
essay.en: I can make many kinds of dishes, some salty, some spicy, all fragrant.

essay.zh: 我做的烤魚，一條只要三十分鐘，還在比賽中得了第一名。
essay.py: Wǒ zuò de kǎoyú, yītiáo zhǐyào sānshífēn zhōng, háizài bǐsài zhōngdé le dìyìmíng.
essay.en: My grilled fish takes only thirty minutes each, and it even won first place in a competition.

essay.zh: 老師問了一句：「你的想法是什麼？」我答：「做菜要用心。」
essay.py: Lǎoshī wènle yījù: “nǐ de xiǎngfǎ shì shénme?” Wǒdá: “zuòcài yào yòngxīn.”
essay.en: The teacher asked, "What's your idea?" I answered, "Cooking needs your heart."

essay.zh: 我畫了一張圖，把做菜的方法分成三個部分。
essay.py: Wǒhuà le yī zhāngtú, bǎ zuòcài de fāngfǎ fēnchéng sāngè bùfen.
essay.en: I drew a picture and divided the cooking method into three parts.

essay.zh: 我在本子上寫了三行字。老師說：「很棒！你很有能力。」我還送每個同學一包糖。
essay.py: Wǒ zài běnzi shàng xiě le sānháng zì. Lǎoshī shuō: “hěnbàng! Nǐ hěn yǒu nénglì.” Wǒ háisòng měigè tóngxué yībāo táng.
essay.en: I wrote three lines in my notebook. The teacher said, "Great! You're very capable." I also gave each classmate a pack of candy.

essay.zh: 同學把我的菜全部吃完了，所有的人都說：「行！你真行！」
essay.py: Tóngxué bǎ wǒ de cài quánbù chī wán le, suǒyǒu de rén dōu shuō: “xíng! Nǐ zhēnxíng!”
essay.en: My classmates ate all my food, and everyone said, "OK! You're really good!"

essay.zh: 今天我去幫助鄰居的小朋友做功課。
essay.py: Jīntiān wǒ qù bāngzhù línjū de xiǎopéngyǒu zuò gōngkè.
essay.en: Today I went to help the neighbor's kid with homework.

essay.zh: 進屋子以前，我先脫鞋子。
essay.py: Jìn wūzi yǐqián, wǒ xiāntuō xiézi.
essay.en: Before entering the house, I took off my shoes.

essay.zh: 屋子裡停電了，沒有網路，也沒有燈。小朋友說：「好黑呀！」
essay.py: Wūzi lǐtíngdiàn le, méiyǒu wǎnglù, yě méiyǒu dēng. Xiǎopéngyǒu shuō: “hǎo hēi ya!”
essay.en: The power was out: no internet, no lights. The kid said, "It's so dark!"

essay.zh: 我以為要等很久，可是一下子電就來了。
essay.py: Wǒ yǐwéi yào děng hěn jiǔ, kěshì yīxiàzi diànjiùlái le.
essay.en: I thought we'd wait a long time, but the power came back in a moment.

essay.zh: 他家有一台新電腦，我們一起看了一部電影，吃了一盒餅乾。
essay.py: Tājiā yǒu yītái xīn diànnǎo, wǒmen yīqǐ kàn le yībù diànyǐng, chī le yīhé bǐnggān.
essay.en: His family has a new computer. We watched a movie together and ate a box of cookies.

essay.zh: 有的餅乾很甜，我替他加了一杯牛奶。他媽媽也做了一道菜。
essay.py: Yǒude bǐnggān hěntián, wǒtì tājiā le yībēi niúnǎi. Tā māma yě zuò le yīdào cài.
essay.en: Some cookies were very sweet, so I got him a glass of milk. His mom also made a dish.

essay.zh: 他送我一支筆和一份小禮物，說下星期有一場足球比賽。「好啦，我要回家啦！」
essay.py: Tā sòng wǒ yīzhī bǐhé yīfèn xiǎo lǐwù, shuō xiàxīngqī yǒu yīchǎng zúqiú bǐsài. “Hǎo la, wǒyào huíjiā la!”
essay.en: He gave me a pen and a small gift, and said there's a soccer match next week. "OK, I'm heading home!"

essay.zh: 我在台南出生，我的父母現在還住在那裡。
essay.py: Wǒ zài táinán chūshēng, wǒ de fùmǔ xiànzài háizhù zài nàlǐ.
essay.en: I was born in Tainan, and my parents still live there.

essay.zh: 我父親是一個很認真的男人，母親是一個美麗的女人。
essay.py: Wǒ fùqīn shì yīgè hěn rènzhēn de nánrén, mǔqīn shì yīgè měilì de nǚrén.
essay.en: My father is a very conscientious man, and my mother is a beautiful woman.

essay.zh: 他們年紀大了，我常常擔心他們。
essay.py: Tāmen niánjì dà le, wǒ chángcháng dānxīn tāmen.
essay.en: They're getting older, and I often worry about them.

essay.zh: 不過，他們跟鄰居的關係很好，生活很開心。
essay.py: Búguò, tāmen gēn línjū de guānxì hěn hǎo, shēnghuó hěn kāixīn.
essay.en: However, they get along well with the neighbors and live happily.

essay.zh: 剛才母親打電話說，父親不久以前生病了，我很傷心。
essay.py: Gāngcái mǔqīn dǎ diànhuà shuō, fùqīn bùjiǔ yǐqián shēngbìng le, wǒ hěn shāngxīn.
essay.en: Just now Mother called and said Father got sick not long ago. I'm very sad.

essay.zh: 以前父親在公司用傳真工作，常常工作到夜裡。
essay.py: Yǐqián fùqīn zài gōngsī yòng chuánzhēn gōngzuò, chángcháng gōngzuò dào yèlǐ.
essay.en: Father used to work with fax machines at his company, often until late at night.

essay.zh: 我們的想法不同，可是父母一直教我要有禮貌。
essay.py: Wǒmen de xiǎngfǎ bùtóng, kěshì fùmǔ yīzhí jiào wǒ yào yǒu lǐmào.
essay.en: Our ideas are different, but my parents always taught me to be polite.

words.en: to carry on back, to shoulder
to be under an attack of fever
to be ache, to be in pain, to be sore
save sb.'s life, Help!, Save me!

essay.zh: 上個星期我感冒了，發燒、咳嗽，背和脖子都很疼，腿也很累。
essay.py: Shànggè xīngqí wǒ gǎnmào le, fāshāo, késòu, bèi hé bózi dōu hěn téng, tuǐ yě hěn lèi.
essay.en: Last week I caught a cold: fever, cough, my back and neck ached, and my legs were tired.

essay.zh: 我的心情很差，感覺很不舒服。
essay.py: Wǒ de xīnqíng hěnchà, gǎnjué hěn bù shūfu.
essay.en: My mood was bad, and I felt really unwell.

essay.zh: 我去醫院掛號，醫生說：「不用擔心，吃藥休息就好。」
essay.py: Wǒ qù yīyuàn guàhào, yīshēng shuō: “búyòng dānxīn, chīyào xiūxí jiù hǎo.”
essay.en: I registered at the hospital. The doctor said, "No need to worry. Take medicine and rest."

essay.zh: 在台灣有健康保險，看病不貴。
essay.py: Zài táiwān yǒu jiànkāng bǎoxiǎn, kànbìng bùguì.
essay.en: Taiwan has health insurance, so seeing a doctor isn't expensive.

essay.zh: 我去藥房買藥，也買了一支新牙刷。
essay.py: Wǒ qù yàofáng mǎiyào, yě mǎi le yīzhī xīn yáshuā.
essay.en: I went to the pharmacy for medicine and also bought a new toothbrush.

essay.zh: 路上我看到一輛救護車，有人大叫：「救命！」
essay.py: Lùshàng wǒ kàndào yīliàng jiùhùchē, yǒurén dàjiào: “jiùmìng!”
essay.en: On the way I saw an ambulance, and someone shouted, "Help!"

essay.zh: 我的室友很害羞，可是她很關心我。生病影響了我的工作，可是有人關心我，我覺得很幸福。
essay.py: Wǒ de shìyǒu hěn hàixiū, kěshì tā hěn guānxīn wǒ. Shēngbìng yǐngxiǎng le wǒ de gōngzuò, kěshì yǒurén guānxīn wǒ, wǒ juéde hěn xìngfú.
essay.en: My roommate is shy, but she cares about me. Being sick affected my work, but someone cares about me, and I feel very lucky.

words.en: to teach in school; to teach (usu for a living)
to hold a meeting, to hold a council

essay.zh: 我姊姊本來在學校教書，後來當了一家公司的經理。
essay.py: Wǒ zǐzǐ běnlái zài xuéxiào jiāoshū, hòulái dāngle yījiā gōngsī de jīnglǐ.
essay.en: My sister used to teach at a school; later she became a company manager.

essay.zh: 她不但要管理很多人，而且常常要開會、寫報告。
essay.py: Tā bùdàn yào guǎnlǐ hěnduō rén, érqiě chángcháng yào kāihuì, xiě bàogào.
essay.en: She not only manages many people but also often has meetings and writes reports.

essay.zh: 她說，做經理必須很小心。比方說，大家的安全很重要，危險的事不能做。
essay.py: Tā shuō, zuò jīnglǐ bìxū hěn xiǎoxīn. Bǐfāngshuō, dàjiā de ānquán hěn zhòngyào, wéixiǎn de shì bùnéng zuò.
essay.en: She says a manager must be careful. For example, everyone's safety is important; dangerous things can't be done.

essay.zh: 她也許很累，可是她很成功。她說，什麼事都有可能。
essay.py: Tā yěxǔ hěnlèi, kěshì tā hěn chénggōng. Tā shuō, shénme shì dōu yǒu kěnéng.
essay.en: She may be tired, but she is very successful. She says anything is possible.

essay.zh: 原來她家很小，只好把臥室當書房。
essay.py: Yuánlái tājiā hěnxiǎo, zhǐhǎo bǎ wòshì dāng shūfáng.
essay.en: Her home turned out to be small, so she had to use the bedroom as a study.

essay.zh: 現在她有一個大房子，有兩間臥室和一間浴室。她可能下個月就搬家。
essay.py: Xiànzài tā yǒu yīgè dàfángzi, yǒu liǎngjiān wòshì hé yījiān yùshì. Tā kěnéng xiàgè yuè jiù bānjiā.
essay.en: Now she has a big house with two bedrooms and a bathroom. She'll probably move next month.

essay.zh: 週末她在家休息或去運動。
essay.py: Zhōumò tā zàijiā xiūxí huò qù yùndòng.
essay.en: On weekends she rests at home or goes exercising.

words.en: to be lively, to be fun, to be bustling with noise
to make a noise, to disturb, to quarrel/to be noisy

essay.zh: 我是一個中學老師，教數學和歷史。
essay.py: Wǒ shì yīgè zhōngxué lǎoshī, jiào shùxué hé lìshǐ.
essay.en: I'm a middle school teacher; I teach math and history.

essay.zh: 我住在鄉下，這裡的環境很好。
essay.py: Wǒ zhù zài xiāngxià, zhèlǐ de huánjìng hěn hǎo.
essay.en: I live in the countryside. The environment here is very good.

essay.zh: 晴天的時候很暖和，晚上很涼快，大概二十度。
essay.py: Qíngtiān de shíhòu hěn nuǎnhuo, wǎnshàng hěn liángkuài, dàgài èrshídù.
essay.en: On sunny days it's warm, and in the evening it's cool, about twenty degrees.

essay.zh: 晚上我打開窗戶，可以看見月亮和星星。
essay.py: Wǎnshàng wǒ dǎkāi chuānghu, kěyǐ kànjian yuèliàng hé xīngxing.
essay.en: At night I open the window and can see the moon and stars.

essay.zh: 我的鄰居家很熱鬧，常常有朋友來，有時候有一點吵。
essay.py: Wǒ de línjū jiā hěn rènao, chángcháng yǒu péngyǒu lái, yǒushíhou yǒuyīdiǎn chǎo.
essay.en: My neighbor's place is lively; friends often come over, and sometimes it's a bit noisy.

essay.zh: 我花了很多時間學書法，寫漢字讓我心情很好。我每天也喝很多開水。
essay.py: Wǒhuā le hěnduō shíjiān xué shūfǎ, xiě hànzì ràng wǒ xīnqíng hěn hǎo. Wǒ měitiān yě hē hěnduō kāishuǐ.
essay.en: I've spent a lot of time learning calligraphy; writing characters puts me in a good mood. I also drink lots of boiled water every day.

essay.zh: 我家沒有洗衣機，所以我常常去鄰居家洗衣服。
essay.py: Wǒjiā méiyǒu xǐyījī, suǒyǐ wǒ chángcháng qù línjū jiā xǐyīfú.
essay.en: I don't have a washing machine, so I often wash clothes at my neighbor's.

to agree, to consent, to approve
to be bored; to be boring and uninteresting; to be a nuisance; to be nonsensical
measure word for the course of an action from the beginning to the end

essay.zh: 我是一個大學生，在語言學院讀書。
essay.py: Wǒ shì yīgè dàxuéshēng, zài yǔyán xuéyuàn dúshū.
essay.en: I'm a university student studying at the college of languages.

essay.zh: 這個學期，我們常在校園的操場上討論功課。
essay.py: Zhègè xuéqí, wǒmen chángzài xiàoyuán de cāochǎng shàng tǎolùn gōngkè.
essay.en: This semester we often discuss schoolwork on the campus sports field.

essay.zh: 我的書桌上有書、筆和一把尺。
essay.py: Wǒ de shūzhuō shàng yǒu shū, bǐhé yībǎ chǐ.
essay.en: On my desk there are books, pens and a ruler.

essay.zh: 老師說，一篇文章要讀三遍才能了解。我同意。
essay.py: Lǎoshī shuō, yīpiān wénzhāng yàodú sānbiàn cáinéng liǎojiě. Wǒ tóngyì.
essay.en: The teacher says you must read an article three times to understand it. I agree.

essay.zh: 雖然讀書有時候有一點無聊，可是也很有趣。
essay.py: Suīrán dúshū yǒushíhou yǒuyīdiǎn wúliáo, kěshì yě hěn yǒuqù.
essay.en: Although studying is sometimes a bit boring, it's also interesting.

essay.zh: 暑假我在餐廳打工，服務客人；寒假我坐地鐵和船去旅行。
essay.py: Shǔjià wǒ zài cāntīng dǎgōng, fúwù kèrén; hánjià wǒ zuò dìtiě hé chuán qù lǚxíng.
essay.en: In summer vacation I work part-time at a restaurant serving customers; in winter vacation I travel by subway and boat.

essay.zh: 放假很好，可是明年我就要畢業了。
essay.py: Fàngjià hěn hǎo, kěshì míngnián wǒ jiùyào bìyè le.
essay.en: Vacations are great, but next year I'll graduate.

words.en: to stand up, get up, to lift, to rise
to happen, to occur, take place
to look after, to care for
to host, to invite, to treat sb (to dinner etc)

essay.zh: 上個週末我開車去市中心。
essay.py: Shànggè zhōumò wǒ kāichē qù shìzhōngxīn.
essay.en: Last weekend I drove downtown.

essay.zh: 台北的交通很亂，車子常常不動。
essay.py: Táiběi de jiāotōng hěnluàn, chēzi chángcháng bùdòng.
essay.en: Taipei's traffic is chaotic; the cars often don't move.

essay.zh: 我先去加油，然後把車停在停車場。
essay.py: Wǒ xiān qù jiāyóu, ránhòu bǎ chētíng zài tíngchēchǎng.
essay.en: First I got gas, then parked in a parking lot.

essay.zh: 下車以後，我發現鑰匙不見了！這些事一起發生，我很著急。
essay.py: Xiàchē yǐhòu, wǒ fāxiàn yàoshi bújiàn le! Zhèxiē shì yīqǐ fāshēng, wǒ hěn zhù jí.
essay.en: After getting out, I found my key was missing! All these things happened at once; I was anxious.

essay.zh: 後來我找到了鑰匙，搭捷運去找朋友，他幫我拿行李。
essay.py: Hòulái wǒ zhǎodào le yàoshi, dā jiéyùn qù zhǎo péngyǒu, tā bāng wǒ ná xínglǐ.
essay.en: Later I found the key and took the MRT to meet my friend, who helped carry my luggage.

essay.zh: 朋友說，出口在那邊，我走錯方向了，那些人都在等我們上車。
essay.py: Péngyǒu shuō, chūkǒu zài nàbiān, wǒ zǒu cuò fāngxiàng le, nàxiē rén dōu zài děng wǒmen shàngchē.
essay.en: My friend said the exit was over there; I'd gone the wrong way, and those people were waiting for us to get on.

essay.zh: 朋友請客吃飯，他說：「在城市生活要照顧好自己。」
essay.py: Péngyǒu qǐngkè chī fàn, tā shuō: “zài chéngshì shēnghuó yào zhàogù hǎo zìjǐ.”
essay.en: My friend treated me to a meal and said, "Living in the city, you have to take good care of yourself."

prevalent, popular, fashionable, in vogue, spread, rage (of contagious disease)

essay.zh: 我跟朋友約了今天去逛街。
essay.py: Wǒ gēn péngyǒu yuē le jīntiān qù guàngjiē.
essay.en: My friend and I arranged to go shopping today.

essay.zh: 這家店很流行，門口排隊的人很多，店裡也滿了。
essay.py: Zhèjiādiàn hěn liúxíng, ménkǒu páiduì de rén hěnduō, diànlǐ yě mǎn le.
essay.en: This shop is popular; there's a long line outside and it's full inside.

essay.zh: 我買了一件藍色的毛衣、一件綠色的雨衣和一些內衣。
essay.py: Wǒ mǎi le yījiàn lánsè de máoyī, yījiàn lǜsè de yǔyī hé yīxiē nèiyī.
essay.en: I bought a blue sweater, a green raincoat and some underwear.

essay.zh: 朋友買了一件紅色的外套和一個黑色的圓包包。
essay.py: Péngyǒu mǎi le yījiàn hóngsè de wàitào hé yīgè hēisè deyuán bāobāo.
essay.en: My friend bought a red jacket and a round black bag.

essay.zh: 一般來說，這家店的衣服不貴，一雙襪子只要九塊五毛。
essay.py: Yībān lái shuō, zhèjiādiàn de yīfú bùguì, yīshuāng wàzi zhǐyào jiǔkuài wǔmáo.
essay.en: Generally, this shop's clothes aren't expensive; a pair of socks is only 9.50.

essay.zh: 回家的時候，我發現錢包被偷了，錢都沒了，我只好把舊雨衣丟了，穿新的。
essay.py: Huíjiā de shíhòu, wǒ fāxiàn qiánbāo bèi tōu le, qián dōu méi le, wǒ zhǐhǎo bǎ jiù yǔyī diūle, chuān xīn de.
essay.en: On the way home I found my wallet was stolen and my money was gone. I had to throw away my old raincoat and wear the new one.

essay.zh: 我把濕衣服換下來，放在太陽光下弄乾。
essay.py: Wǒ bǎ shī yīfú huànxià lái, fàngzài tàiyáng guāngxià nòngqián.
essay.en: I changed out of my wet clothes and put them in the sunlight to dry.

words.en: ①to accept, to receive; ②to collect, to gather

essay.zh: 我的興趣很多，比方說美術、體育和音樂。
essay.py: Wǒ de xìngqù hěnduō, bǐfāngshuō měishù, tǐyù hé yīnyuè.
essay.en: I have many interests, for example art, sports and music.

essay.zh: 我經常去公園散步，也去爬山。我也會一種樂器：吉他。
essay.py: Wǒ jīngcháng qù gōngyuán sànbù, yě qù páshān. Wǒ yě huì yīzhǒng yuèqì: jítā.
essay.en: I often take walks in the park and go hiking. I can also play an instrument: the guitar.

essay.zh: 今天看新聞，有一個可怕的消息：河水太髒了，很多魚都死了。
essay.py: Jīntiān kàn xīnwén, yǒu yīgè kěpà de xiāoxí: héshuǐ tài zāng le, hěnduō yúdōu sǐ le.
essay.en: Today the news had a terrible story: the river water is too dirty, and many fish died.

essay.zh: 上課我遲到了，沒有座位，只好站著。
essay.py: Shàngkè wǒ chídào le, méiyǒu zuòwèi, zhǐhǎo zhàn zhù.
essay.en: I was late to class; there were no seats, so I had to stand.

essay.zh: 下課以後，我跟老師談了一下，他收了我的作業。
essay.py: Xiàkè yǐhòu, wǒ gēn lǎoshī tán le yíxià, tāshōu le wǒ de zuòyè.
essay.en: After class I talked with the teacher for a bit, and he took my homework.

essay.zh: 上課結束以後，我在圖書館看完了一本雜誌。
essay.py: Shàngkè jiéshù yǐhòu, wǒ zài túshūguǎn kàn wán le yīběn zázhì.
essay.en: After class ended, I finished reading a magazine in the library.

words.en: ①measure word for people; ②Mouthful, measure word for things kept in the mouth
native language; mother tongue; (linguistics) parent language
midnight, (in)the middle of the night, half a night

essay.zh: 我的母語不是中文，可是在台灣的日子很有意思。
essay.py: Wǒ de mǔyǔ búshì Zhōngwén, kěshì zài táiwān de rìzi hěn yǒuyìsi.
essay.en: My native language isn't Chinese, but my days in Taiwan are interesting.

essay.zh: 白天我在餐廳工作，夜晚回家做飯。
essay.py: Báitiān wǒ zài cāntīng gōngzuò, yèwǎn huíjiā zuòfàn.
essay.en: During the day I work in a restaurant; at night I go home and cook.

essay.zh: 我常買新鮮的米、牛排和許多青菜。
essay.py: Wǒchángmǎi xīnxiān de mǐ, niúpái hé xǔduō qīngcài.
essay.en: I often buy fresh rice, steak and lots of vegetables.

essay.zh: 做牛排只要加一點鹽就很好吃。每次做好菜，我先嚐一口。
essay.py: Zuò niúpái zhǐyào jiā yīdiǎn yán jiù hěn hǎochī. Měicì zuòhǎo cài, wǒ xiāncháng yīkǒu.
essay.en: Steak just needs a little salt to taste good. Each time I finish cooking, I taste a bite first.

essay.zh: 牆上的時鐘說，已經半夜十二點了。
essay.py: Qiángshàng de shízhōng shuō, yǐjīng bànyè shíèr diǎnle.
essay.en: The clock on the wall says it's already midnight.

essay.zh: 我把餅乾裝在盒子裡寄給朋友，在表上寫了她的住址。
essay.py: Wǒ bǎ bǐnggān zhuāngzài hézi lǐjìgěi péngyǒu, zài biǎoshàng xiě le tā de zhùzhǐ.
essay.en: I packed cookies in a box to mail to a friend and wrote her address on the form.

essay.zh: 郵局的人問：「等等，你還要寄任何其他東西嗎？」
essay.py: Yóujú de rénwèn: “děngděng, nǐ háiyào jì rènhé qítā dōngxi ma?”
essay.en: The post office clerk asked, "Wait, do you want to send anything else?"

words.en: just right, at the right moment
father's older brother, uncle (address to male of father's generation)
wife of father's elder brother, aunt
father's younger brother, uncle, uncle (child's address for young males)

one's mother's sister, auntie; address to woman of similar age as parents

essay.zh: 春季的時候，我們全家去外公外婆家。
essay.py: Chūnjì de shíhòu, wǒmen quánjiā qù wàigōng wàipójiā.
essay.en: In spring our whole family went to Grandpa and Grandma's (mom's side).

essay.zh: 那時正好放假，伯伯、叔叔、姑姑和阿姨都來了。
essay.py: Nàshí zhènghǎo fàngjià, bóbo, shúshu, gūgu hé āyí dōu lái le.
essay.en: It happened to be a holiday, so my uncles, aunts all came.

essay.zh: 外婆有三個孫子和兩個孫女。
essay.py: Wàipó yǒusāngè sūnzi hé liǎnggè sūnnǚ.
essay.en: Grandma has three grandsons and two granddaughters.

essay.zh: 伯父很帥，伯母做菜很好吃。
essay.py: Bófù hěnshuài, bómǔ zuòcài hěn hǎochī.
essay.en: My uncle is handsome, and his wife's cooking is delicious.

essay.zh: 我和兄弟去河邊玩，弟弟很害怕，不敢下水。
essay.py: Wǒ hé xiōngdì qù hébiān wán, dìdi hěn hàipà, bùgǎn xiàshuǐ.
essay.en: My brothers and I played by the river. My little brother was scared and didn't dare go in the water.

essay.zh: 哥哥說他笨，媽媽很急，叫我們早點回家。
essay.py: Gēge shuō tā bèn, māma hěn jí, jiào wǒmen zǎodiǎn huíjiā.
essay.en: My older brother called him silly. Mom was anxious and told us to come home early.

way of looking at sth, view
to do, to handle, to manage, to set up, to run
work part-time while studying in college/etc
to check, to investigate, to look up

essay.zh: 我長大以後，一邊念書，一邊打工。
essay.py: Wǒ zhǎngdà yǐhòu, yībiān niànshū, yībiān dǎgōng.
essay.en: After I grew up, I studied and worked part-time at the same time.

essay.zh: 我的身高一百八十公分，老闆常常要我搬東西。
essay.py: Wǒ de shēngāo yìbǎibāshí gōngfēn, lǎo bǎn chángcháng yào wǒ bān dōngxi.
essay.en: I'm 180 cm tall, so my boss often asks me to move things.

essay.zh: 老闆也常常要我加班，這個問題很嚴重。
essay.py: Lǎo bǎn yě chángcháng yào wǒ jiābān, zhègè wèntí hěn yánzhòng.
essay.en: My boss also often makes me work overtime. This problem is serious.

essay.zh: 明天我要考試，所以晚上在家查資料。
essay.py: Míngtiān wǒyào kǎoshì, suǒyǐ wǎnshàng zàijiā chá zīliào.
essay.en: I have a test tomorrow, so tonight I'm looking up information at home.

essay.zh: 考試有十題，第一個題目很難。
essay.py: Kǎoshì yǒushítí, dìyī gè tímù hěnnán.
essay.en: The test has ten questions; the first one is hard.

essay.zh: 我不知道答案，就想了一些例子，例如我自己的經驗。
essay.py: Wǒ bù zhīdào dá'àn, jiù xiǎng le yīxiē lìzi, lìrú wǒ zìjǐ de jīngyàn.
essay.en: I didn't know the answer, so I thought of some examples, such as my own experience.

essay.zh: 我跟同學談我們的看法和做法。下個月我要選一個正式的工作。
essay.py: Wǒ gēn tóngxué tán wǒmen de kànfǎ hé zuòfǎ. Xiàgè yuè wǒ yào xuǎnyīgè zhèngshì de gōngzuò.
essay.en: I discussed our views and methods with classmates. Next month I'll choose a formal job.

essay.zh: 媽媽一直在我身邊，她說：「別急，這件事我們一起辦。」
essay.py: Māma yīzhí zài wǒ shēnbiān, tā shuō: “biéjí, zhèjiàn shì wǒmen yīqǐ bàn.”
essay.en: Mom is always by my side. She said, "Don't rush. We'll handle this together."

words.en: write an essay, a composition, an article, to compose
subtract, reduce, decrease, cut, lessen, diminish, deduct
to be false, fake, a sham, phony
to change, to alter, to correct

essay.zh: 我的室友是國小老師，教英語和數學。
essay.py: Wǒ de shìyǒu shì guóxiǎo lǎoshī, jiào Yīngyǔ hé shùxué.
essay.en: My roommate is an elementary school teacher who teaches English and math.

essay.zh: 她教小朋友加、減、乘、除。
essay.py: Tā jiào xiǎopéngyǒu jiā, jiǎn, chéng, chú.
essay.en: She teaches kids addition, subtraction, multiplication and division.

essay.zh: 她班上有二十個學生，加上她自己，一共二十一個人。
essay.py: Tā bānshàng yǒu èrshí gè xuéshēng, jiāshàng tā zìjǐ, yígòng èrshíyī gè rén.
essay.en: Her class has twenty students; adding herself, that's twenty-one people.

essay.zh: 我的教授要我們寫中文作文，我常寫錯詞和文法，教授幫我改。
essay.py: Wǒ de jiàoshòu yào wǒmen xiě Zhōngwén zuòwén, wǒchángxiě cuòcí hé wénfǎ, jiàoshòu bāng wǒ gǎi.
essay.en: My professor has us write Chinese essays. I often get words and grammar wrong, and the professor corrects them.

essay.zh: 他說：「學中文很有意思，那是我教書的原因。」
essay.py: Tā shuō: “xué Zhōngwén hěn yǒuyìsi, nà shì wǒ jiāoshū de yuányīn.”
essay.en: He said, "Learning Chinese is interesting. That's why I teach."

essay.zh: 我告訴室友我中了一百萬，她說：「那是假的吧！」
essay.py: Wǒ gàosù shìyǒu wǒ zhōng le yìbǎi wàn, tā shuō: “nà shì jiǎ de ba!”
essay.en: I told my roommate I won a million, and she said, "That's fake, right?"

essay.zh: 春假我們坐火車去旅行，我找到位子，把書包放在上面。回家以後，我把書放在書架上，把本子放在桌上。
essay.py: Chūnjià wǒmen zuò huǒchē qù lǚxíng, wǒ zhǎodào wèizi, bǎ shūbāo fàngzài shàngmiàn. Huíjiā yǐhòu, wǒ bǎ shū fàngzài shūjià shàng, bǎ běnzi fàngzài zhuōshàng.
essay.en: On spring break we traveled by train. I found a seat and put my school bag above it. At home I put my books on the shelf and my notebook on the table.

words.en: under the condition of, under, beneath, below

partial measure word for: ①the storeys of a building; ②an outer covering.

essay.zh: 我在大學研究教育。
essay.py: Wǒ zài dàxué yánjiù jiàoyù.
essay.en: I research education at university.

essay.zh: 我很用功，每天在書房讀三個小時以上的書。
essay.py: Wǒ hěn yònggōng, měitiān zài shūfáng dúsāngè xiǎoshí yǐshàng de shū.
essay.en: I'm hardworking and read for over three hours a day in my study.

essay.zh: 我的教授給我很多建議和意見。
essay.py: Wǒ de jiàoshòu gěiwǒ hěnduō jiànyì hé yìjiàn.
essay.en: My professor gives me lots of suggestions and opinions.

essay.zh: 他說，知識很重要，可是選擇也很重要。
essay.py: Tā shuō, zhīshì hěn zhòngyào, kěshì xuǎnzé yě hěn zhòngyào.
essay.en: He says knowledge is important, but choices are important too.

essay.zh: 我的中文程度不高，所以要趕快學。
essay.py: Wǒ de Zhōngwén chéngdù bùgāo, suǒyǐ yào gǎnkuài xué.
essay.en: My Chinese level isn't high, so I need to hurry and learn.

essay.zh: 我家是一座三層的房子，一樓有餐桌，二樓有臥房。
essay.py: Wǒjiā shì yīzuò sāncéng de fángzi, yīlóu yǒu cānzhuō, èrlóu yǒu wòfáng.
essay.en: My home is a three-story house; there's a dining table on the first floor and bedrooms on the second.

essay.zh: 院子裡有一個大箱子，櫃子裡放著舊書，我常忘記把書放回去。
essay.py: Yuànzi lǐyǒu yīgè dàxiāngzi, guìzilǐ fàngzhù jiùshū, wǒcháng wàngjì bǎ shūfàng huíqù.
essay.en: There's a big box in the yard, and old books in the cabinet. I often forget to put books back.

essay.zh: 冬天氣溫在零度以下的時候，我們就在家裡看書。
essay.py: Dōngtiān qìwēn zài língdùyǐxià de shíhòu, wǒmen jiù zàijiā lǐkàn shū.
essay.en: In winter, when it's below zero, we stay home and read.

words.en: a landlord or landlady, a lessor
individual measure word for cloudand flowers
①to be deep; ②profound or difficult(for); ③(of colors)dark or deep

essay.zh: 上個月底我搬家了。
essay.py: Shànggè yuèdǐ wǒ bānjiā le.
essay.en: I moved at the end of last month.

essay.zh: 新房子的房東很好，可是房屋很舊，屋子裡很亂。
essay.py: Xīnfángzi de fángdōng hěn hǎo, kěshì fángwū hěnjiù, wūzi lǐhěnluàn.
essay.en: The new landlord is nice, but the house is old and messy inside.

essay.zh: 大門外面有一棵樹，樹底下開著幾朵花。
essay.py: Dàmén wàimiàn yǒu yīkē shù, shù dǐxia kāizhù jǐ duǒhuā.
essay.en: Outside the front door there's a tree, with a few flowers blooming under it.

essay.zh: 夏天是颱風的季節，天氣很濕，蚊子也很多。
essay.py: Xiàtiān shì táifēng de jìjié, tiānqì hěnshī, wénzi yě hěnduō.
essay.en: Summer is typhoon season; the weather is humid and there are many mosquitoes.

essay.zh: 颱風來的時候，我的傘都壞了。
essay.py: Táifēng lái de shíhòu, wǒ de sǎndōu huài le.
essay.en: When the typhoon came, my umbrellas all broke.

essay.zh: 房東說，大家要做環保，垃圾要分類，才不會汙染環境。
essay.py: Fángdōng shuō, dàjiā yào zuò huánbǎo, lèsè yào fēnlèi, cái búhuì wūrǎn huánjìng.
essay.en: The landlord says we must be eco-friendly and sort garbage so we don't pollute the environment.

essay.zh: 三天內，我把房子整理好了。附近有一條很深的河，晚上很涼，自然環境很美。
essay.py: Sāntiān nèi, wǒ bǎ fángzi zhěnglǐ hǎo le. Fùjìn yǒu yītiáo hěn shēn de hé, wǎnshàng hěnliáng, zìrán huánjìng hěn měi.
essay.en: Within three days I tidied up the house. Nearby there's a deep river; nights are cool and nature is beautiful.

words.en: ①shallow; easy, simple; ②superficial; ③light (of color)
grab, seize, arrest, catch, press-gang, pay special attention to, be responsible for, take charge of

essay.zh: 假日早上，鬧鐘一響我就起床。
essay.py: Jiàrì zǎoshàng, nàozhōng yīxiǎng wǒ jiù qǐchuáng.
essay.en: On a day off, I get up as soon as the alarm rings.

essay.zh: 我穿上拖鞋，拿毛巾、牙膏和肥皂去洗手間。別忘了衛生紙！
essay.py: Wǒ chuān shàng tuōxié, ná máojīn, yágāo hé féizào qù xǐshǒujiān. Bié wàng le wèishēngzhǐ!
essay.en: I put on slippers and take a towel, toothpaste and soap to the bathroom. Don't forget toilet paper!

essay.zh: 然後我去公園慢跑，跑得一直流汗。
essay.py: Ránhòu wǒ qù gōngyuán mànpǎo, pǎode yīzhí liúhàn.
essay.en: Then I go jogging in the park and sweat the whole time.

essay.zh: 中午我和朋友去河邊野餐，我們用籃子帶食物。
essay.py: Zhōngwǔ wǒ hé péngyǒu qù hébiān yěcān, wǒmen yòng lánzi dài shíwù.
essay.en: At noon my friends and I have a picnic by the river; we carry food in a basket.

essay.zh: 河水很淺，也流得很慢，小孩子在河裡抓魚。
essay.py: Héshuǐ hěn qiǎn, yě liúde hěnmàn, xiǎoháizi zài hélǐ zhuāyú.
essay.en: The river is shallow and flows slowly; kids catch fish in it.

essay.zh: 我的朋友是一個畫家，她拍了很多照片，回家要畫畫。
essay.py: Wǒ de péngyǒu shì yīgè huàjiā, tā pāi le hěnduō zhàopiàn, huíjiā yào huàhuà.
essay.en: My friend is a painter; she took many photos to paint at home.

essay.zh: 晚上我用刷子洗鞋，寫日記，然後把頭放在枕頭上，做了一個好夢。
essay.py: Wǎnshàng wǒyòng shuāzi xǐxié, xiě rìjì, ránhòu bǎtóu fàngzài zhěntou shàng, zuò le yīgè hǎo mèng.
essay.en: In the evening I scrub my shoes with a brush, write in my diary, then lay my head on the pillow and have a good dream.

words.en: it seems, it looks as if
to accompany, to keep sb company
to use, to take advantage of, to pexploit
to cooperate, to collaborate, to work together

essay.zh: 週末，我陪朋友去參加一個派對。
essay.py: Zhōumò, wǒ péi péngyǒu qù cānjiā yīgè pàiduì.
essay.en: On the weekend I went to a party with a friend.

essay.zh: 主人是我的老同學，她看起來很高興。
essay.py: Zhǔrén shì wǒ de lǎo tóngxué, tā kànqǐlái hěn gāoxìng.
essay.en: The host is my old classmate; she looked very happy.

essay.zh: 我們一邊喝茶一邊聊，也玩遊戲、跳舞。
essay.py: Wǒmen yībiān hēchá yībiān liáo, yě wán yóuxì, tiàowǔ.
essay.en: We chatted over tea and played games and danced.

essay.zh: 派對的目的是讓大家認識新朋友。主人要求大家合作，一起做菜。
essay.py: Pàiduì de mùdì shì ràng dàjiā rènshì xīn péngyǒu. Zhǔrén yāoqiú dàjiā hézuò, yīqǐ zuòcài.
essay.en: The party's purpose was to meet new friends. The host asked everyone to cooperate and cook together.

essay.zh: 第二天，我跟一個女生約會，我們先去茶館，再去游泳池。
essay.py: Dìèrtiān, wǒ gēn yīgè nǚshēng yuēhuì, wǒmen xiān qù cháguǎn, zài qù yóuyǒngchí.
essay.en: The next day I went on a date with a girl. We went to a teahouse first, then a swimming pool.

essay.zh: 游泳池的門票只要一百塊，我們游了一個小時。
essay.py: Yóuyǒngchí de ménpiào zhǐyào yìbǎi kuài, wǒmen yóu le yīgè xiǎoshí.
essay.en: The swimming pool ticket was only 100 dollars, and we swam for an hour.

essay.zh: 我利用週末休息，覺得很輕鬆。每件事都有好處和壞處，可是今天的情形都很好。
essay.py: Wǒ lìyòng zhōumò xiūxí, juéde hěn qīngsōng. Měijiànshì dōu yǒu hǎochù hé huàichù, kěshì jīntiān de qíngxíng dōu hěn hǎo.
essay.en: I used the weekend to rest and felt relaxed. Everything has pros and cons, but today everything went well.

essay.zh: 春節是台灣最重要的節日。
essay.py: Chūnjié shì táiwān zuì zhòngyào de jiérì.
essay.en: Lunar New Year is Taiwan's most important holiday.

essay.zh: 除夕晚上，全家人一塊吃年夜飯，大家同時說：「新年快樂！」
essay.py: Chúxì wǎnshàng, quánjiārén yíkuài chī nián yèfàn, dàjiā tóngshí shuō: “xīnnián kuàilè!”
essay.en: On New Year's Eve the whole family eats dinner together and everyone says at the same time, "Happy New Year!"

essay.zh: 在這些傳統當中，我最喜歡吃年夜飯。
essay.py: Zài zhèxiē chuántǒng dāngzhōng, wǒ zuì xǐhuān chī nián yèfàn.
essay.en: Of all these traditions, I like the New Year's Eve dinner most.

essay.zh: 現代很多人用手機寄郵件，可是我寫了一封信，貼上郵票，放進信箱，祝朋友新年快樂。
essay.py: Xiàndài hěnduō rényòng shǒujī jì yóujiàn, kěshì wǒ xiě le yīfēngxìn, tiē shàng yóupiào, fàngjìn xìnxiāng, zhù péngyǒu xīnnián kuàilè.
essay.en: Nowadays many people send email by phone, but I wrote a letter, put on a stamp, dropped it in the mailbox, and wished my friend a happy new year.

essay.zh: 她給我回信說：「放心，我一切都很好。」
essay.py: Tāgěi wǒ huíxìn shuō: “fàngxīn, wǒ yíqiè dōu hěn hǎo.”
essay.en: She wrote back, "Don't worry, everything is fine with me."

essay.zh: 我出門的時候，給家人留了一張紙。新的一年帶來新的希望。
essay.py: Wǒ chūmén de shíhòu, gěi jiārén liú le yī zhāngzhǐ. Xīn de yīnián dàilái xīn de xīwàng.
essay.en: When I went out, I left my family a note. The new year brings new hope.

essay.zh: 法律保護大家的安全，所以放煙火要小心。
essay.py: Fǎlǜ bǎohù dàjiā de ānquán, suǒyǐ fàngyān huǒyào xiǎoxīn.
essay.en: The law protects everyone's safety, so be careful setting off fireworks.

words.en: to joke; to make fun of
time difference, jet lag, equation of time

essay.zh: 我從美國飛到台灣，有十二個小時的時差。
essay.py: Wǒ cóng Měiguó fēidào táiwān, yǒu shíèr gè xiǎoshí de shíchā.
essay.en: I flew from the US to Taiwan; there's a twelve-hour time difference.

essay.zh: 台北市區的交通很方便，我常搭捷運。
essay.py: Táiběi shìqū de jiāotōng hěn fāngbiàn, wǒcháng dā jiéyùn.
essay.en: Getting around downtown Taipei is convenient; I often take the MRT.

essay.zh: 在月台上，一位老太太對我說：「加油！你的中文很好。」她是在開玩笑嗎？
essay.py: Zài yuè táishàng, yīwèi lǎotàitai duì wǒ shuō: “jiāyóu! Nǐ de Zhōngwén hěn hǎo.” Tā shì zài kāi wánxiào ma?
essay.en: On the platform, an old lady said to me, "Keep it up! Your Chinese is good." Was she joking?

essay.zh: 在台灣，到處都是機車。
essay.py: Zài táiwān, dàochù dōu shì jīchē.
essay.en: In Taiwan, there are scooters everywhere.

essay.zh: 週末我們坐巴士走公路去北投，巴士的速度很快，我們選的地點也很好。
essay.py: Zhōumò wǒmen zuò bāshì zǒu gōnglù qù běitóu, bāshì de sùdù hěnkuài, wǒmen xuǎn de dìdiǎn yě hěn hǎo.
essay.en: On the weekend we took a bus along the highway to Beitou. The bus was fast, and the spot we chose was great.

essay.zh: 北投的溫泉很有名，可惜那天人太多。
essay.py: Běitóu de wēnquán hěn yǒumíng, kěxí nàtiān réntàiduō.
essay.en: Beitou's hot springs are famous; too bad there were too many people that day.

essay.zh: 我喜歡台灣社會的自由，在很多方面都很好。
essay.py: Wǒ xǐhuān táiwān shèhuì de zìyóu, zài hěnduō fāngmiàn dōu hěn hǎo.
essay.en: I like the freedom of Taiwanese society; it's good in many ways.
