essay.zh: 我的朋友是一個有錢的商人，他做生意去過非洲、美洲和歐洲。
essay.py: Wǒ de péngyǒu shì yīgè yǒuqián de shāngrén, tā zuòshēngyì qùguò Fēizhōu, Měizhōu hé Ōuzhōu.
essay.en: My friend is a rich businessman. He has been to Africa, the Americas and Europe on business.

essay.zh: 今年他來亞洲旅行，先去中國大陸，再來台灣。
essay.py: Jīnnián tālái Yàzhōu lǚxíng, xiān qù Zhōngguó dàlù, zàilái táiwān.
essay.en: This year he traveled in Asia, first to mainland China, then Taiwan.

essay.zh: 他說東方的文化很有意思。來台灣以前，他辦了簽證。
essay.py: Tā shuō dōngfāng de wénhuà hěn yǒuyìsi. Lái táiwān yǐqián, tā bàn le qiānzhèng.
essay.en: He says Eastern culture is fascinating. Before coming to Taiwan, he got a visa.

essay.zh: 他背著一個大背包，背包上有一個鎖。
essay.py: Tā bèizhù yīgè dà bēibāo, bēibāo shàng yǒu yīgèsuǒ.
essay.en: He carried a big backpack with a lock on it.

essay.zh: 在博物館的入口，他拍照拍了很久，流了很多汗。
essay.py: Zài bówù guǎn de rùkǒu, tā pāizhào pāi le hěn jiǔ, liú le hěnduō hàn.
essay.en: At the museum entrance he took photos for a long time and sweated a lot.

essay.zh: 後來他的臉色不好，說他頭痛。休息一下以後，他的精神好多了，一切正常。
essay.py: Hòulái tā de liǎnsè bùhǎo, shuō tā tóutòng. Xiūxí yíxià yǐhòu, tā de jīngshén hǎoduō le, yīqièzhèngcháng.
essay.en: Later he looked pale and said he had a headache. After a rest, he felt much better and everything was normal.

essay.zh: 他說台灣的服務標準很高。
essay.py: Tā shuō táiwān de fúwù biāozhǔn hěn gāo.
essay.en: He said Taiwan's service standards are high.

words.en: to be succeed in obtaining, to gain, to receive
carry, take (in hand with arm down), lift, raise

essay.zh: 今天百貨公司打折，我跟朋友去逛街。
essay.py: Jīntiān bǎihuògōngsī dǎzhé, wǒ gēn péngyǒu qù guàngjiē.
essay.en: The department store had a sale today, so I went shopping with a friend.

essay.zh: 我買了一件上衣、一雙皮鞋和一雙手套。店員說可以刷卡，我就刷卡了。
essay.py: Wǒ mǎi le yījiàn shàngyī, yīshuāng píxié hé yīshuāng shǒutào. Diànyuán shuō kěyǐ shuākǎ, wǒ jiù shuākǎ le.
essay.en: I bought a top, a pair of leather shoes and a pair of gloves. The clerk said I could pay by card, so I did.

essay.zh: 我們提著很多東西去吃飯，可是餐廳客滿了，因為我們沒有訂位。
essay.py: Wǒmen tízhù hěnduō dōngxi qù chī fàn, kěshì cāntīng kèmǎn le, yīnwèi wǒmen méiyǒu dìngwèi.
essay.en: We carried lots of bags to dinner, but the restaurant was full because we hadn't booked a table.

essay.zh: 下次要早一點訂。
essay.py: Xiàcì yào zǎo yīdiǎn dìng.
essay.en: Next time we need to book earlier.

essay.zh: 晚上我們去逛夜市，老闆娘送我們一杯茶。
essay.py: Wǎnshàng wǒmen qùguàng yèshì, lǎo bǎn niáng sòng wǒmen yībēi chá.
essay.en: In the evening we went to the night market, and the lady boss gave us a cup of tea.

essay.zh: 我在口袋裡找到一些零錢。在台灣，一般不用給小費。
essay.py: Wǒ zài kǒudài lǐ zhǎodào yīxiē língqián. Zài táiwān, yībān búyòng gěi xiǎofèi.
essay.en: I found some change in my pocket. In Taiwan you usually don't need to tip.

essay.zh: 買到便宜的東西不困難，今天我得到了很多快樂。
essay.py: Mǎidào piányí de dōngxi bù kùnnán, jīntiān wǒ dédào le hěnduō kuàilè.
essay.en: It isn't hard to find cheap things; today I got a lot of joy.

words.en: container measure word for things in a bag or a sack
collective measure word for a group of things used togather

essay.zh: 我每個月存一點零用錢。
essay.py: Wǒ měigè yuè cún yīdiǎn língyòngqián.
essay.en: I save a little pocket money every month.

essay.zh: 我的早餐很簡單：一個饅頭、一杯豆漿。
essay.py: Wǒ de zǎocān hěn jiǎndān: yīgè mántou, yībēi dòujiāng.
essay.en: My breakfast is simple: a steamed bun and a cup of soy milk.

essay.zh: 中午我吃一個熱狗或火腿三明治，喝可樂。
essay.py: Zhōngwǔ wǒ chī yīgè règǒu huò huǒtuǐsānmíng zhì, hē kělè.
essay.en: At noon I eat a hot dog or a ham sandwich and drink cola.

essay.zh: 週末我去一家高級餐廳吃海鮮和沙拉。
essay.py: Zhōumò wǒ qù yījiā gāojí cāntīng chī hǎixiān hé shālā.
essay.en: On weekends I go to a fancy restaurant for seafood and salad.

essay.zh: 我最喜歡的水果是芒果、葡萄和橘子。我買了一袋水果，可是袋子破了！
essay.py: Wǒ zuì xǐhuān de shuǐguǒ shì mángguǒ, pútao hé júzi. Wǒ mǎi le yīdài shuǐguǒ, kěshì dàizi pò le!
essay.en: My favorite fruits are mango, grapes and tangerines. I bought a bag of fruit, but the bag broke!

essay.zh: 回家以後，我喝了一杯烏龍茶，吃了豆腐。
essay.py: Huíjiā yǐhòu, wǒ hē le yībēi wūlóngchá, chī le dòufu.
essay.en: At home I drank a cup of oolong tea and ate tofu.

essay.zh: 我還買了一套新衣服，很適合我，大小也很合適。
essay.py: Wǒ háimǎi le yītào xīn yīfú, hěn shìhé wǒ, dàxiǎo yě hěn héshì.
essay.en: I also bought a new outfit. It suits me, and the size fits well.

words.en: ①individual measure word for small and roundish things in nature; ②individual measure word for a tooth
ripe, cooked, done, deep (sleep, thoughts etc)
to be extremely, to be exceedingly
some other, an additional or a different one

essay.zh: 除了奶茶，我也喜歡喝汽水。
essay.py: Chúle nǎichá, wǒ yě xǐhuān hē qìshuǐ.
essay.en: Besides milk tea, I also like soda.

essay.zh: 我在汽水裡加了冰塊，喝了一罐。
essay.py: Wǒ zài qìshuǐ lǐjiā le bīngkuài, hē le yīguàn.
essay.en: I added ice cubes to my soda and drank a can.

essay.zh: 夜市的臭豆腐聞起來很臭，可是吃起來香得不得了！
essay.py: Yèshì de chòudòufǔ wén qǐlái hěn chòu, kěshì chī qǐlái xiāngde bùdéliǎo!
essay.en: Night market stinky tofu smells awful, but it tastes amazing!

essay.zh: 那家店的炒飯和炸雞也很好吃。不管多忙，我都會去吃一次。
essay.py: Nàjiādiàn de chǎo fàn hé zhà jī yě hěn hǎochī. Bùguǎn duōmáng, wǒ dōu huì qù chī yīcì.
essay.en: That shop's fried rice and fried chicken are delicious too. No matter how busy I am, I go once.

essay.zh: 我還買了一顆很熟的芒果當甜點。這樣的味道多麼好！
essay.py: Wǒ háimǎi le yīkē hěn shú de mángguǒ dāng tiándiǎn. Zhèyàng de wèidào duōme hǎo!
essay.en: I also bought a ripe mango for dessert. What a wonderful taste!

essay.zh: 朋友說：「你不必每次都吃一樣的，可以試試別的。」
essay.py: Péngyǒu shuō: “nǐ búbì měicì dōu chī yíyàng de, kěyǐ shìshì biéde.”
essay.en: My friend said, "You don't have to eat the same thing every time. Try something else."

essay.zh: 我說：「我就喜歡那樣的味兒。」
essay.py: Wǒ shuō: “wǒ jiù xǐhuān nàyàng de wèir.”
essay.en: I said, "I just like that kind of flavor."

essay.zh: 我從來沒有在山上過夜。上個月我跟三個朋友去了，其中一個是我的同學。
essay.py: Wǒ cónglái méiyǒu zài shānshàng guòyè. Shànggè yuè wǒ gēn sāngè péngyǒu qù le, qízhōng yīgè shì wǒ de tóngxué.
essay.en: I had never spent the night on a mountain. Last month I went with three friends; one of them is my classmate.

essay.zh: 天氣相當好，尤其是早上，好極了。
essay.py: Tiānqì xiāngdāng hǎo, yóuqí shì zǎoshàng, hǎojí le.
essay.en: The weather was quite good, especially the morning; it was excellent.

essay.zh: 我們先爬山，接著做飯。
essay.py: Wǒmen xiān páshān, jiēzhe zuòfàn.
essay.en: We hiked first, then cooked.

essay.zh: 沒想到晚上下大雨，結果我們整個晚上都沒睡。
essay.py: Méi xiǎngdào wǎnshàng xià dàyǔ, jiéguǒ wǒmen zhěnggè wǎnshàng dōu méi shuì.
essay.en: Unexpectedly it rained hard at night, and as a result we didn't sleep all night.

essay.zh: 雨越下越大，我們立刻回到車上。
essay.py: Yǔyuè xià yuè dà, wǒmen lìkè huídào chēshàng.
essay.en: The rain got heavier and heavier, and we immediately went back to the car.

essay.zh: 其實我完全不怕，只要有朋友在，一切都好。
essay.py: Qíshí wǒ wánquán bùpà, zhǐyào yǒu péngyǒu zài, yíqiè dōu hǎo.
essay.en: Actually I wasn't scared at all; as long as my friends are there, everything is fine.

essay.zh: 還好第二天早上雨已停了，我們大概十點就到家了。我正在想，下次最好先看天氣。
essay.py: Háihǎo dìèrtiān zǎoshàng yǔ yǐ tíng le, wǒmen dàgài shídiǎn jiù dào jiā le. Wǒ zhèngzài xiǎng, xiàcì zuìhǎo xiānkàn tiānqì.
essay.en: Luckily the rain had stopped the next morning, and we got home around ten. I'm thinking that next time I'd better check the weather first.

essay.zh: 我第一次來台灣是五年前，當時我連一個中文字都不會。
essay.py: Wǒ dìyīcì lái táiwān shì wǔnián qián, dāngshí wǒlián yīgè zhōng wénzì dōu búhuì.
essay.en: The first time I came to Taiwan was five years ago; back then I couldn't even read one Chinese character.

essay.zh: 「哇！這裡的一切都很新。」我說。那時我的房間很空，什麼家具都沒有。
essay.py: “Wa! Zhèlǐ de yíqiè dōu hěn xīn.” Wǒ shuō. Nàshí wǒ de fángjiān hěnkōng, shénme jiājù dōu méiyǒu.
essay.en: "Wow! Everything here is new," I said. My room was empty then, with no furniture.

essay.zh: 外國人來台灣須辦簽證，可是我的朋友剛好也住在附近，她幫了我很多。
essay.py: Wàiguó rénlái táiwānxū bàn qiānzhèng, kěshì wǒ de péngyǒu gānghǎo yě zhù zài fùjìn, tā bāng le wǒ hěnduō.
essay.en: Foreigners must get a visa to come to Taiwan, but luckily my friend lived nearby and helped me a lot.

essay.zh: 我每天走一萬步左右，一步一步認識台北，生活所需的東西都很方便買到。
essay.py: Wǒ měitiān zǒu yīwànbù zuǒyòu, yībù yībù rènshì táiběi, shēnghuó suǒ xū de dōngxi dōu hěn fāngbiàn mǎidào.
essay.en: I walked about ten thousand steps every day, getting to know Taipei step by step; everything you need for daily life was easy to buy.

essay.zh: 比方說，我學會了泡茶，也知道茶有很多類，包括烏龍茶和紅茶。每樣我都喜歡，且都不貴。
essay.py: Bǐfāngshuō, wǒxuéhuì le pàochá, yě zhīdào cháyǒu hěnduō lèi, bāokuò wūlóngchá hé hóngchá. Měiyàng wǒ dōu xǐhuān, qiě dōu bùguì.
essay.en: For example, I learned to brew tea and learned there are many kinds, including oolong and black tea. I like every kind, and they're all inexpensive.

essay.zh: 有時候我很煩，就直接去找朋友，或者打電話給媽媽。另外，另一個朋友常常把照片傳給我。
essay.py: Yǒushíhou wǒ hěnfán, jiù zhíjiē qù zhǎo péngyǒu, huòzhě dǎ diànhuà gěi māma. Lìngwài, lìng yīgè péngyǒu chángcháng bǎ zhàopiàn chuángěi wǒ.
essay.en: When I felt annoyed, I went straight to my friends or called Mom. Also, another friend often sent me photos.

essay.zh: 有空的時候，我同樣喜歡去爬山。等到我會說中文的時候，我的快樂多了兩倍。台灣人總是很友善。
essay.py: Yǒukòng de shíhòu, wǒ tóngyàng xǐhuān qù páshān. Děngdào wǒhuì shuō Zhōngwén de shíhòu, wǒ de kuàilè duō le liǎngbèi. Táiwān rén zǒngshì hěn yǒushàn.
essay.en: When I have free time, I also like hiking. By the time I could speak Chinese, my happiness had doubled. Taiwanese people are always friendly.
